title_translated: KoNeoBench：韩语新词理解的大语言模型评估数据集
summary_translated: 大语言模型通常在静态基准上进行评估，然而自然语言不断通过新出现的词汇和意义演化。现有的韩语基准集中于既定词汇，因此对近期词汇变化覆盖有限，且其英语导向的设计难以评估韩语的类型学特性，其中实词常与功能语素富有成效地组合。本文提出KoNeoBench，一个用于评估LLMs对韩语新词理解能力的基准。KoNeoBench基于2020年以来在线新闻中记录的1785个韩语新词，经专家词典学审查整理而成。每个条目提供用法示例、构词分析和词典式定义。基于此资源，我们定义了四项任务，并报告了近期模型的表现及人工基准结果。实验表明，当前LLMs在恢复源成分、区分语义类别和生成准确定义方面存在明显局限。这些结果揭示了当前LLMs在应对近期韩语词汇变化方面的具体挑战。KoNeoBench可在https://github.com/bcmilab/ko-neobench/ 获取。

summary: Pronouns, adverbs and other functional words (such as they, her, somewhere, there) are often used in language to replace concrete nouns or phrases, when their properties - such as gender, grammatical number - provide sufficient information for the given context. Do pretrained transformer models encode such functional words in a manner that allows them to be used like humans do? Can language models recognize the syntactic and semantic parallelism of sentences such as "The researchers wrote the paper" and "They wrote it", which relies on such lexical abstraction?   We map these linguistic questions into the embedding space of a pretrained transformer model, and compare representations of nouns, with the representations of the pronouns and adverbs that can replace these nouns, in isolation and in parallel lexicalized and functional sentences. We then probe for shared syntactic and semantic structure in the embeddings of parallel lexicalized and functional sentences.   We find that functional words are located centrally compared to nouns, but are also distinct, which is congruent with their behaviour as place-holders in a wide variety of contexts.   The analysis of the embeddings of parallel (lexicalized and functional) sentences show them inhabiting different subspaces of the embedding space. Experiments that distil the structural information of the sentence show that training on either type of data does not reveal the shared structure - because of the over-consistency of the vocabulary (in case of the functional data), and the too much variety (in case of the lexicalized versions). However, training with a mix of functional and lexicalized sentences, the shared structure emerges.
title: Generalization through Lexical Abstraction in Transformer Models: The Case of Functional Words
title_translated: Transformer模型中通过词汇抽象实现泛化：功能词的案例
summary_translated: 代词、副词等功能词（如they、her、somewhere、there）在语言中常用于替代具体名词或短语，当其属性（如性别、语法数）在特定上下文中提供足够信息时。预训练的Transformer模型是否以类似人类的方式编码这些功能词？语言模型能否识别“研究人员写了论文”和“他们写了它”这类句子之间的句法与语义平行性，这种平行性依赖于词汇抽象？我们将这些语言学问题映射到预训练Transformer模型的嵌入空间中，比较名词与其可替换的代词和副词在孤立及并行词汇化和功能化句子中的表示。随后，我们探测并行词汇化和功能化句子嵌入中的共享句法和语义结构。研究发现，功能词相对于名词位于更中心的位置，但又具有独特性，这与其在各种上下文中作为占位符的行为一致。对并行（词汇化与功能化）句子嵌入的分析表明它们占据嵌入空间的不同子空间。实验显示，仅在单一类型数据上训练无法揭示共享结构——因为功能化数据存在过度一致性，而词汇化版本则过于多样化。然而，在混合功能化与词汇化句子的训练下，共享结构得以显现。

summary: Interpreter agents built on machine translation (MT) increasingly mediate live conversation between people who do not share a language, yet we still evaluate them with metrics built for isolated sentences, which measure fidelity rather than whether communication succeeds. We introduce a reusable three-layer checklist-and-judge framework that evaluates interpreter-mediated conversation across semantic, pragmatic, and cultural-social dimensions, covering the naturalness, intent, and social appropriateness that fidelity metrics leave unmeasured. It runs in both single-turn and interactive multi-turn settings, where simulated users reply to translated messages as the conversation unfolds and each turn is scored alongside the conversation as a whole. We extensively validate it through controlled perturbations, cross-judge comparisons, and human annotations. Our main single-turn benchmark evaluates 10 interpreter setups across Arabic, Bengali, Indonesian, and Korean from 5,624 OpenSubtitles-derived scenarios spanning 12 translation directions, and our multi-turn study covers all 6 language pairs in scripted and live modes. Results show a consistent decline from semantic to pragmatic and cultural-social success, while conventional MT metrics overlook failures among stronger interpreters, and prompt ablations show that scenario context, structured instructions, and cultural context improve communicative success, although gains vary across setups. Our work thus provides an evaluation framework and benchmark for interpreter agents in conversation, and highlights the importance of communicative success alongside existing translation metrics.
title: Evaluating Communicative Success in Machine-Translated Conversation
title_translated: 机器翻译对话中沟通成功的评估
summary_translated: 基于机器翻译（MT）构建的翻译代理越来越多地在不同语言者之间实时中介对话，但我们仍使用为孤立句子设计的评估指标，这些指标衡量的是忠实度而非沟通是否成功。我们提出一个可复用的三层检查清单与评分框架，从语义、语用和文化社会维度评估翻译中介对话的效果，涵盖忠实度指标未覆盖的自然性、意图传达和社交适宜性。该框架适用于单轮和交互式多轮场景，模拟用户在对话过程中对翻译消息作出回应，并对每一轮及整个对话进行评分。我们通过受控扰动、跨评委对比和人工标注进行了广泛验证。主要单轮基准测试评估了10种翻译设置在阿拉伯语、孟加拉语、印度尼西亚语和韩语之间的表现，涵盖5,624个源自OpenSubtitles的场景，共12种翻译方向；多轮研究覆盖所有6种语言对的脚本模式和实时模式。结果表明，从语义到语用再到文化社会层面的成功率持续下降，而传统MT指标忽略了强翻译器中的失败情况。提示消融实验显示，场景上下文、结构化指令和文化背景能提升沟通成功率，尽管增益因设置而异。本工作为对话中的翻译代理提供了评估框架与基准，并强调了沟通成功在现有翻译指标之外的重要性。

summary: Characterizing LLM reasoning remains an open challenge, as many existing benchmarks isolate specific reasoning skills, rely on external knowledge, or are costly to extend. We introduce PetriBench, a compact, fully self-contained, and scalable benchmark for evaluating LLM reasoning over dynamic state spaces using Petri nets, a mature formalism for modeling real-world concurrent and distributed systems. PetriBench organizes reasoning into four task families varying by scope and temporal horizon, with Easy, Medium, and Hard levels generated by increasing structural complexity and evaluated against exact ground truth. Across a diverse set of proprietary and open-weight models, accuracy decreases consistently with difficulty, while harder instances expose increasingly distinct task-specific capability profiles. Additional analyses show that test-time compute improves performance but interacts differently with different reasoning tasks, and that procedural generation yields smooth scaling with structural complexity. Together, these results show that PetriBench provides a unified and extensible setting for probing the strengths, limits, and scaling behavior of LLM reasoning.
title: PetriBench: Benchmarking LLM Reasoning over Dynamic State Spaces
title_translated: PetriBench：面向动态状态空间的LLM推理基准测试
summary_translated: 刻画大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力仍是开放挑战，因为现有基准往往局限于特定推理技能、依赖外部知识或扩展成本高昂。我们引入PetriBench，一个紧凑、完全自包含且可扩展的基准，用于评估LLM在动态状态空间上的推理能力，采用Petri网这一成熟的建模形式来描述现实世界中的并发与分布式系统。PetriBench将推理任务组织为四类任务家族，按范围和时间跨度变化，通过增加结构复杂度生成易、中、难三个等级，并以精确的真值进行评估。在一系列专有和开源权重模型上的测试显示，准确率随难度递增而持续下降，更难的任务暴露出越来越明显的任务特异性能力特征。额外分析表明，推理时计算资源的增加可提升性能，但对不同推理任务的影响方式各异；而过程生成方法则实现了结构复杂度下的平滑扩展。综合来看，PetriBench为探究LLM推理的优势、局限性和扩展行为提供了一个统一且可扩展的评测环境。

summary: The KV cache has become a major bottleneck in deploying LLMs, as its memory footprint grows linearly with sequence length and batch size, imposing substantial pressure on both memory capacity and bandwidth. Among various KV cache compression techniques, quantization is particularly attractive due to its effectiveness and ease of deployment. However, most existing methods rely on fixed-width quantization, where a $b$ bit representation is inherently limited to $2^b$ quantization levels. As the bit width decreases, the number of available levels shrinks exponentially, leading to severe information loss and rapid performance degradation. We further observe that fixed-width quantization fails to exploit the highly non-uniform distribution of KV cache. After rotation and normalization, KV values approximately follow a normal distribution, with most values concentrated near the center and only a small fraction appearing in the tails. Nevertheless, fixed-width coding allocates the same number of bits to frequent and rare symbols. Entropy coding naturally exploits such non-uniformity by assigning shorter codewords to frequent symbols and longer ones to rare symbols, substantially reducing the average number of bits required for representation. However, its variable-length output is not suited to highly parallel attention kernels, where efficient dequantization and computation rely on regular memory layouts and fixed-stride accesses. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{D-Quant}, a flexible KV cache quantization framework that introduces a \textbf{drift} mechanism to convert entropy-coded representations of each token into fixed-size bitstreams, enabling regular memory access and parallel dequantization within attention kernels.
title: D-Quant: Driftable Entropy Coding for KV Cache Quantization
title_translated: D-Quant：用于KV缓存量化中的可漂移熵编码
summary_translated: KV缓存已成为部署大语言模型的主要瓶颈，因其内存占用随序列长度和批量大小线性增长，对内存容量和带宽造成巨大压力。在多种KV缓存压缩技术中，量化因其高效性和部署简便性而尤为吸引人。然而，大多数现有方法依赖固定位宽量化，其中b位表示本质上受限于2^b个量化级别。随着位宽降低，可用级别呈指数级减少，导致严重的信息损失和性能急剧下降。我们进一步观察到，固定位宽量化未能利用KV缓存的高度非均匀分布特性。经过旋转和归一化后，KV值近似服从正态分布，大部分值集中在中心区域，仅有少量出现在尾部。然而，固定位宽编码对频繁和稀有符号分配相同数量的比特。熵编码天然能够利用这种非均匀性，为频繁符号分配较短码字，为稀有符号分配较长码字，显著降低平均表示所需比特数。但其可变长度输出不适合高度并行的注意力核函数，因为高效的反量化和计算依赖于规则的内存布局和固定步长访问。为弥合这一差距，我们提出	extbf{D-Quant}，一种灵活的KV缓存量化框架，引入	extbf{漂移}机制，将每个标记的熵编码表示转换为固定大小的比特流，从而在注意力核内实现规则内存访问和并行反量化。

summary: Question answering has advanced rapidly with large language models, but predominantly for high-resource languages, in both text and spoken settings. Spoken question answering (SQA) benchmark for Telugu remains unexplored, and the reliability of automatic evaluation in this setting remains unquantified. We introduce VākQA, a Telugu SQA benchmark of 2,001 factoid question-answer pairs across six domains, with 2.53 hours of speech audio, bilingual transcriptions, and human-verified reference answers. We first validate evaluation methods against human judgements: Gemini-as-a-judge best approximates human ratings but is non-uniformly strict, while open-weight judges systematically penalize correct Telugu answers that differ in surface form from the reference. Using this validated setup, we benchmark proprietary and open-weight models across input modality, language, and domain. We observe that Telugu phrasing retains cultural specificity that is lost in translation, speech input introduces phonetic confusions that alter question meaning, and cascaded ASR-MT errors compound progressively. VākQA is publicly released.
title: VākQA: A Benchmark and Evaluation Study for Telugu Spoken Factoid Question Answering
comment: Paper is accepted in IEEE SLT 2026
title_translated: VākQA：泰卢固语口语事实型问答的基准与评估研究
summary_translated: 随着大语言模型的发展，问答系统取得了快速进展，但主要集中在高资源语言，且在文本和口语两种场景中均有体现。泰卢固语口语问答（SQA）基准尚未被探索，该场景下自动评估的可靠性也未量化。我们引入VākQA，一个包含2,001个事实型问答对的泰卢固语SQA基准，覆盖六个领域，包含2.53小时语音音频、双语转录文本以及经人工验证的参考答案。我们首先通过与人类判断对比验证评估方法：Gemini-as-a-judge最接近人类评分，但存在非均匀严格性；而开源模型裁判则系统性地惩罚表面形式与参考答案不同的正确泰卢固语回答。基于此验证后的设置，我们对专有和开源模型在输入模态、语言和领域方面进行了基准测试。我们观察到，泰卢固语表达保留了文化特异性，翻译中容易丢失；语音输入引入了音素混淆，改变了问题含义；级联的ASR-MT错误会逐层累积。VākQA已公开发布。

summary: Efficient long-term conversational memory requires retrieving sufficient evidence without indiscriminately expanding the context presented to the language model. This is challenging because relevant evidence may be distributed across multiple sessions, while compression may discard details needed for answering. Different queries therefore require different forms of memory access. To capture these demands, we formulate memory access along two dimensions: discovery breadth, which controls how broadly evidence is searched, and reading fidelity, which controls whether evidence is read in compact form or recovered from the original conversation. Based on this formulation, we introduce JustMem, which stores conversation history as compact atomic memories and adapts memory access along these two dimensions to each query. Specifically, LOOKUP handles local evidence, COMPOSE broadens discovery for distributed evidence, and REPLAY increases reading fidelity for fidelity-sensitive evidence. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S, JustMem achieves the highest mean accuracy and retrieval recall among the compared memory systems while using substantially fewer generative-model tokens for memory construction and inference.
title: JustMem: Just-Enough Memory Access for Long-Term Conversations
title_translated: JustMem：面向长期对话的适量记忆访问
summary_translated: 高效的长期对话记忆需要在不无差别地扩展语言模型输入上下文的前提下，检索足够的证据。这具有挑战性，因为相关证据可能分散在多个会话中，而压缩可能会丢弃回答所需的关键细节。因此，不同的查询需要不同形式的记忆访问。为捕捉这些需求，我们从两个维度定义记忆访问：发现广度（控制证据搜索的范围）和读取保真度（控制证据是以紧凑形式读取还是从原始对话中恢复）。基于此，我们提出JustMem，将对话历史存储为紧凑的原子记忆，并根据每个查询动态调整这两个维度的记忆访问策略。具体而言，LOOKUP处理局部证据，COMPOSE扩大发现范围以获取分散的证据，REPLAY则提高对保真度敏感的证据的读取保真度。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S基准上，JustMem在对比的记忆系统中实现了最高的平均准确率和检索召回率，同时在记忆构建和推理过程中使用了显著更少的生成模型token。

summary: Autoregressive language models (ARMs) are constrained by sequential, left-to-right generation, while masked diffusion models (MDMs) enable parallel decoding but suffer from high computational overhead due to the inability to reuse Key-Value (KV) cache and from incoherent generation arising from learning dependencies over an intractable space of token combinations. We introduce Zarya, a family of hybrid language models that jointly optimizes an autoregressive (AR) objective and a masked-diffusion objective within a single architecture. Zarya structures training data into variable-size slots and employs a curriculum that gradually increases slot granularity, enabling a smooth transition from fine-grained AR learning to coarse-grained diffusion learning. At inference, Zarya provides two distinct decoding paradigms through a unified interface: (i) MDM sampling with first-hitting denoising, and (ii) slotted speculative decoding that interleaves inter-slot diffusion-based selection with intra-slot autoregressive infilling, achieving full KV cache reuse. The training and inference regimes are fully decoupled, allowing a model trained with any configuration to be deployed in either mode. Extensive configurability --- including grouped noise patterns (Prefix Completion, Fill-In-the-Prefix, Fill-In-the-Middle), ordered sampling schedules, and noise-level permutation strategies --- enables flexible research exploration. We release Zarya models publicly in sizes 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B, demonstrating performance on standard benchmarks while offering a principled integration of autoregressive and diffusion paradigms.
title: Zarya: A Hybrid Autoregressive--Masked Diffusion Language Model with Flexible Training and Dual-Mode Inference

title_translated: Zarya：一种具有灵活训练与双模式推理的混合自回归-掩码扩散语言模型
summary_translated: 自回归语言模型（ARMs）受限于顺序的、从左到右的生成方式，而掩码扩散模型（MDMs）虽支持并行解码，但因无法重用键值（KV）缓存且在难以处理的词元组合依赖空间中学习导致生成不连贯，从而带来高计算开销。我们提出Zarya，一个在单一架构中联合优化自回归（AR）目标与掩码扩散（MDM）目标的混合语言模型家族。Zarya将训练数据组织为可变大小的槽位，并采用渐进式课程学习，逐步增加槽位粒度，实现从细粒度AR学习到粗粒度扩散学习的平滑过渡。在推理阶段，Zarya通过统一接口提供两种不同的解码范式：(i) 基于首次击中去噪的MDM采样，以及(ii) 插槽式的推测解码，该方法在插槽间交错进行基于扩散的选择与插槽内自回归填充，实现完整的KV缓存重用。训练与推理完全解耦，使得任何配置训练出的模型均可部署于任一模式。丰富的可配置性——包括分组噪声模式（前缀补全、前缀填空、中间填空）、有序采样调度和噪声级别置换策略——支持灵活的研究探索。我们公开发布了0.6B、1.7B和4B三种规模的Zarya模型，在标准基准上展示了优异性能，同时提供了自回归与扩散范式的原则性融合。

summary: With the widespread industrial deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), DeepSearch has emerged as the dominant paradigm for resolving complex user queries. It typically operates through an iterative closed-loop workflow consisting of planning and reflection, information retrieval, and answer generation. However, existing reward models (RMs) and evaluation benchmarks are primarily designed for static single-turn tasks, failing to capture the full-pipeline complexity of DeepSearch workflows. To address this limitation, we propose F2DR, a fine-grained full-pipeline DeepSearch reward framework. F2DR evaluates DeepSearch workflows across three dimensions: Content, Trajectory, and Answer, enabling comprehensive process-level assessment. We further construct DeepSearch RM-Bench, a dedicated benchmark for evaluating RMs in DeepSearch scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that F2DR achieves significantly higher evaluation consistency than self-evaluation-based baselines, while DeepSearch RM-Bench exhibits strong discriminative capability across existing open-source RMs. We will publicly release the complete DeepSearch RM-Bench dataset soon.
title: F$^{2}$DR: A Fine-Grained Full-Pipeline Reward Framework for DeepSearch Workflows
title_translated: F²DR：面向DeepSearch工作流的细粒度全流程奖励框架
summary_translated: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）在工业中的广泛应用，DeepSearch已成为解决复杂用户查询的主要范式。它通常通过一个包含规划与反思、信息检索和答案生成的迭代闭环工作流运行。然而，现有的奖励模型（RMs）和评估基准主要针对静态单轮任务设计，无法捕捉DeepSearch工作流的全流程复杂性。为解决这一局限，我们提出F2DR，一种细粒度的全流程DeepSearch奖励框架。F2DR从内容、轨迹和答案三个维度评估DeepSearch工作流，实现全面的过程级评估。我们进一步构建了DeepSearch RM-Bench，一个专门用于评估DeepSearch场景下奖励模型的基准测试。大量实验表明，F2DR在评估一致性方面显著优于基于自我评估的基线方法，而DeepSearch RM-Bench在现有开源奖励模型之间展现出强大的区分能力。我们即将公开发布完整的DeepSearch RM-Bench数据集。

summary: Grapheme-to-phoneme (G2P) conversion turns raw text into its phonemic form and is an essential part of both text-to-speech (TTS) and automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems. It is required to be fast, stable and context-aware. For unsegmented languages such as Japanese, G2P additionally couples word segmentation with highly context-dependent polyphone disambiguation, and the scarcity of accurately annotated data remains a bottleneck. In this paper, we present a context-aware neural G2P method that scores paths of a discriminative conditional random field (CRF) over a word lattice constructed from dictionaries. To tackle data scarcity, we utilize large language models (LLMs) to generate more than 2 million sentences. Experimental results demonstrate that our method strongly outperforms conventional morphological analyzer-based methods and neural sequence models. On the Joyo-Kanji-Yomi benchmark, our method reaches 99.62% target word reading accuracy, 0.32% target word phoneme error rate (PER) and 0.14% sentence PER.
title: Dictionary-Constrained Grapheme-to-Phoneme for Unsegmented Languages from LLM-Annotated Data
title_translated: 基于LLM标注数据的未分词语言字形到音素转换方法
summary_translated: 字形到音素（G2P）转换将原始文本转化为其音素形式，是文本到语音（TTS）和自动语音识别（ASR）系统的核心组成部分。它要求快速、稳定且具备上下文感知能力。对于日语等未分词语言，G2P还需将词切分与高度依赖上下文的多音字歧义消解相结合，而高质量标注数据的稀缺仍是瓶颈。本文提出一种上下文感知的神经G2P方法，通过在由词典构建的词图上对判别性条件随机场（CRF）的路径进行评分来实现。为应对数据稀缺问题，我们利用大语言模型（LLMs）生成了超过两百万句文本。实验结果表明，该方法显著优于传统的形态分析器方法和神经序列模型。在Joyo-Kanji-Yomi基准上，我们的方法达到了99.62%的目标词读音准确率、0.32%的目标词音素错误率（PER）和0.14%的句子PER。

summary: LLM-driven evolutionary search finds programs by launching seeds and iterating each one. Papers report a single budget setting, usually one seed run for a fixed number of iterations, and rank methods from that one point. We show this is not enough. We evaluate three evolutionary search strategies on five optimization tasks, commonly used by papers in the genre to report results. We run the analysis over a full grid of seeds and iterations. Our findings suggest that the best way to split a fixed budget between more seeds (width) and more iterations (depth) changes with the strategy, the task, and the total budget. Furthermore, we observe that the ranking of strategies also changes with the budget. On one task the strategy that looks worst at one seed is best at forty seeds. On another the best number of iterations is well below the value common in practice, so extra depth wastes budget that more seeds would turn into score. We provide a measurement protocol that reports the seeds-by-iterations frontier and practical guidance for using it.
title: Evolution or Illusion? Rethinking Evaluation in LLM Evolutionary Search
title_translated: 进化还是幻觉？重新思考大语言模型演化搜索的评估
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型的演化搜索通过启动初始种子并迭代优化程序。论文通常报告单一预算设置，通常是单个种子运行固定次数的迭代，并据此对方法进行排名。我们指出这并不充分。我们在五个常用优化任务上评估了三种演化搜索策略，并在完整的种子与迭代网格上进行分析。研究发现，将固定预算在更多种子（宽度）与更多迭代（深度）之间分配的最佳方式，取决于策略、任务和总预算。此外，我们观察到策略的排名也随预算变化。在某一任务中，单个种子表现最差的策略在四十个种子时反而最佳；在另一任务中，最优迭代次数远低于实践中常见的数值，意味着额外的深度浪费了本可用于增加种子数量以提升得分的预算。我们提供了一种测量协议，用于报告种子与迭代的前沿曲线，并给出实际使用建议。

summary: Hateful memes spread abusive content through implicit interactions between images and text, posing serious threats to the safety of online communities. In recent years, multimodal large language models have been widely used for hateful meme detection and are increasingly adopted to generate explainable detection results. However, we find that existing explain-then-detect methods often couple explanation generation and label prediction within the same training process. This coupling causes interference between task objectives, leading to limited detection performance and even worse results than simple SFT baselines. To address these challenges, we propose ProKDA, a progressive knowledge-to-decision alignment method for explainable hateful meme detection. Inspired by the human annotation training process, ProKDA first uses an agentic background knowledge construction pipeline to obtain external knowledge related to meme understanding. It then adopts a three-stage training strategy that sequentially performs background knowledge learning, hatefulness detection learning, and hatefulness boundary alignment. Unlike prior explain-then-detect methods that jointly optimize both tasks, ProKDA focuses on a single training objective at each stage. This design reduces interference between the two tasks and progressively transforms background knowledge into robust detection decisions. Experiments on three public hateful meme benchmarks show that ProKDA achieves state-of-the-art detection performance and provides accurate, explainable, and evidence-supported decisions for hateful meme moderation. Project page: https://meizhiyuan88666.github.io/prokda.
title: Learn Before You Judge: Progressive Knowledge-to-Decision Alignment for Explainable Hateful Meme Detection
title_translated: 先学习再判断：用于可解释仇恨表情包检测的渐进式知识到决策对齐方法
summary_translated: 仇恨表情包通过图像与文本之间的隐式互动传播有害内容，对在线社区安全构成严重威胁。近年来，多模态大语言模型被广泛用于仇恨表情包检测，并越来越多地用于生成可解释的检测结果。然而，我们发现现有的‘先解释后检测’方法通常在相同的训练过程中耦合解释生成与标签预测任务，这种耦合导致任务目标之间的干扰，从而限制了检测性能，甚至表现不如简单的SFT基线。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了ProKDA——一种用于可解释仇恨表情包检测的渐进式知识到决策对齐方法。受人类标注训练过程启发，ProKDA首先利用智能体式背景知识构建流程获取与表情包理解相关的外部知识；随后采用三阶段训练策略，依次进行背景知识学习、仇恨性检测学习和仇恨性边界对齐。与以往联合优化两个任务的方法不同，ProKDA在每个阶段专注于单一训练目标，从而减少两任务间的干扰，并逐步将背景知识转化为稳健的检测决策。在三个公开仇恨表情包基准上的实验表明，ProKDA实现了最先进的检测性能，并为仇恨表情包治理提供了准确、可解释且有证据支持的决策。项目页面：https://meizhiyuan88666.github.io/prokda。

summary: This paper proposes a phonemically comprehensive, ASCII-only romanization scheme for Thai and Lao, treating the two closely related languages as a unified cross-lingual design problem. The scheme represents segmental contrasts, vowel length, and lexical tone while maintaining one-symbol-one-phoneme transparency and systematic correspondence between Thai and Lao. The scheme prioritizes synchronic phonetic correspondence, including correspondence with Pinyin and Jyutping where applicable, while preserving historical-phonological correspondence where it does not conflict with phonetic transparency. Tone uses a compact single-digit default notation, supplemented by optional tone-value and historical tone-category representations. The resulting scheme provides a readable, keyboard-friendly, and machine-processable phonemic representation for language learning and cross-lingual speech processing.
title: A Phonemically Comprehensive, ASCII-Only Romanization Scheme for Thai and Lao: Systematic Cross-Lingual Correspondence and Chinese-User-Friendly Design
title_translated: 面向泰语和老挝语的音素全面、仅ASCII罗马化方案：系统化的跨语言对应与中文用户友好设计
summary_translated: 本文提出了一种针对泰语和老挝语的音素全面、仅使用ASCII字符的罗马化方案，将这两种密切相关的语言视为统一的跨语言设计问题。该方案能够表示音段对比、元音长度和词汇声调，同时保持一个符号对应一个音素的透明性，并实现泰语与老挝语之间系统化的对应关系。该方案优先考虑共时语音对应，包括与汉语拼音（Pinyin）和粤拼（Jyutping）的对应（如适用），并在不损害语音透明性的前提下保留历史音位对应关系。声调采用紧凑的单数字默认标记，辅以可选的声调值和历史声调类别表示。最终方案为语言学习和跨语言语音处理提供了可读性强、键盘友好且机器可处理的音素表示。

summary: Sequential sentence classification (SSC) is an essential task for structuring scientific publications, and extending SSC research to languages other than English can improve accessibility to scientific knowledge in multilingual digital libraries. Cross-lingual transfer is a promising approach to address the scarcity of training data in non-English languages. Prior work on other natural language processing tasks has shown the benefits of capturing linguistic similarity between source and target languages. However, SSC inherently depends on patterns at the discourse level, such as label sequences and positional regularities, which appear consistently across languages regardless of linguistic differences. To examine the factors that determine transfer success in SSC, we constructed a multilingual SSC dataset covering 13 non-English languages collected from five academic databases. Our cross-lingual transfer experiments, using both encoder-based and generative models, show that linguistic proximity has no consistent predictive power for transfer performance, whereas structural similarity in rhetorical organization shows a weak but consistent positive correlation across models. After controlling for source-language performance, the similarity of label distributions is the most consistent predictor. Building on this finding, we propose a set of three methods that explicitly leverage structural information using generative models. In the in-domain evaluation, the best combination reaches parity with the strongest encoder baselines, and in transfer to languages unseen during training, it outperforms the strongest encoder baseline.
title: Improving Cross-Lingual Transfer for Sequential Sentence Classification in Research Papers via Structural Similarity

title_translated: 通过结构相似性提升科研论文中序列句子分类的跨语言迁移能力
summary_translated: 序列句子分类（SSC）是结构化科学出版物的重要任务，将SSC研究扩展至英语以外的语言有助于提升多语言数字图书馆中科学知识的可及性。跨语言迁移是一种应对非英语语言训练数据稀缺的有前景方法。先前在其他自然语言处理任务中的研究表明，捕捉源语言与目标语言之间的语言相似性具有益处。然而，SSC本质上依赖于话语层面的模式，如标签序列和位置规律，这些模式在不同语言间保持一致，不受语言差异影响。为探究决定SSC迁移成功的关键因素，我们构建了一个涵盖13种非英语语言的多语言SSC数据集，数据来自五个学术数据库。我们的跨语言迁移实验（使用基于编码器和生成式模型）表明，语言接近性对迁移性能无一致预测力，而修辞组织结构相似性在各类模型中表现出微弱但一致的正相关。在控制源语言性能后，标签分布的相似性是最具一致性的预测因子。基于此发现，我们提出一组三种显式利用结构信息的生成式方法。在领域内评估中，最佳组合达到与最强编码器基线相当的性能；在训练中未见语言的迁移中，其表现优于最强编码器基线。

summary: Modern applications generate massive volumes of raw telemetry data, but translating those noisy, heterogeneous event streams into actionable business insights remains a fundamental challenge. Data engineers and analysts expend substantial effort reconciling semantic discrepancies, hand-crafting parsing logics, and maintaining fragile mappings between raw data and business KPIs. In this paper, we present an end-to-end framework that fully automates the construction of a business semantic layer from application raw logs. Our approach introduces a two-stage semantic abstraction: first, high-level business features are identified via LLM inference augmented with domain-specific industry knowledge; second, fine-grained business nodes are derived through a structured pipeline comprising data refinement, hybrid retrieval, multi-stage filtering, semantic clustering, and canonical naming. Evaluation on production-scale telemetry demonstrates that our system improves human-assessed semantic quality from 50 to 80+ on a 100-point scale, reduces maintenance effort by 80%, filters out 74% of noise, and achieves 0.87 Cohen's kappa via an integrated LLM-as-Judge evaluation, enabling continuous, scalable quality assurance. Overall, our work distinguishes itself from prior work by addressing the novel problem of business semantic layer induction from raw telemetry, operating without labeled training data or manual rule engineering.
title: Semantic Layer Induction from Raw Telemetry via Hierarchical LLM and RAG Abstraction
title_translated: 通过分层LLM与RAG抽象从原始遥测数据中诱导语义层
summary_translated: 现代应用生成海量原始遥测数据，但将这些噪声大、异构的事件流转化为可操作的业务洞察仍是根本性挑战。数据工程师和分析师耗费大量精力解决语义差异、手动编写解析逻辑，并维护原始数据与业务KPI之间的脆弱映射。本文提出一个端到端框架，完全自动化地从应用原始日志构建业务语义层。我们的方法引入两阶段语义抽象：第一阶段，通过结合领域特定行业知识的LLM推理识别高层次业务特征；第二阶段，通过包含数据精炼、混合检索、多阶段过滤、语义聚类和规范命名的结构化流程推导出细粒度业务节点。在生产规模遥测数据上的评估显示，我们的系统将人工评估的语义质量从50提升至80+（满分100），维护成本降低80%，噪声过滤率达74%，并通过集成LLM作为裁判的评估获得0.87的Cohen's kappa，实现持续、可扩展的质量保障。总体而言，本工作区别于以往研究之处在于解决了从原始遥测数据中诱导业务语义层这一新问题，且无需标注训练数据或手动规则工程。

summary: This empirical study is an independent reproduction of the dissociation Zhao reported in 2026. The shape of a large language model's chain-of-thought entropy trajectory predicts whether the final answer is correct, while the magnitude of its total entropy drop does not. The dissociation merits reproduction because the magnitude half rests on a single 300-problem run with one model at one seed, while the shape half was reported at full scale on both benchmarks and on a second model family. Registered at OSF before any confirmatory run, the reproduction crosses the complete GSM8K and MATH-500 benchmark test sets with four open-weight models including one reasoning-distilled model of a kind the original did not test. The shape signal replicates. The magnitude signal divides by setting. On the anchor model the accuracy gap between monotone and non-monotone chains is +9.6 percentage points on GSM8K and +27.5 on MATH-500, while the rank correlation of the total entropy drop with correctness is -0.018 on GSM8K and +0.414 on MATH-500. On the reasoning-distilled model the binary form of the shape signal fires on about one chain in a hundred, too few to estimate the registered contrast, while the graded violation count remains predictive there. In an exploratory comparison the final-step entropy alone outperforms the binary shape flag in all eight model-by-benchmark cells by ROC area, and in six or seven by the risk-coverage area the original reports, depending on an integration range the original does not state. The study contributes a reproduction of the shape signal at full test-set scale under seven documented protocol differences, a map of the settings where the magnitude signal holds and fails, and measurements of four protocol dependencies the original does not report.
title: Chain-of-Thought Entropy as a Reliability Signal: A Preregistered Reproduction
title_translated: 思维链熵作为可靠性信号：一项预先注册的复现研究
summary_translated: 本实证研究是对Zhao在2026年报告的分离效应的独立复现。大型语言模型的思维链熵轨迹形状可预测最终答案是否正确，而其总熵下降幅度则不能。该分离效应值得复现，因为其幅度部分仅基于一次300题运行、一个模型在单一随机种子下的结果，而形状部分则在两个基准上以及第二个模型族上均以全规模报告。该复现研究在任何确认性运行前已在OSF注册。我们使用四个开源权重模型（包括一个原研究未测试过的推理提炼模型）完整覆盖GSM8K和MATH-500基准测试集。形状信号成功复现。幅度信号则因设置不同而分裂。在锚定模型上，单调与非单调链之间的准确率差距在GSM8K上为+9.6个百分点，在MATH-500上为+27.5；而总熵下降与正确性的等级相关系数在GSM8K上为-0.018，在MATH-500上为+0.414。在推理提炼模型上，形状信号的二元形式仅约每百条链触发一次，不足以估计注册的对比，但分级违规计数仍具预测性。探索性比较显示，仅最终步熵在所有八个模型-基准单元中，以ROC面积优于二元形状标志；在六或七个单元中，以风险覆盖面积也优于原研究报告，具体取决于原研究未说明的积分范围。本研究贡献了在七项已记录协议差异下，于完整测试集规模对形状信号的复现，一份关于幅度信号有效与失效场景的地图，以及四项原研究未报告的协议依赖性测量。

summary: Full-duplex speech models listen and speak at once, promising always-on assistants. Yet they must also decide when they should speak. Human listeners speak when addressed or when the speaker stops, but also self-select to correct a false claim, supply a missing word, or warn of danger. We ask whether full-duplex models do the same. To separate the reason to speak from the opportunity, we construct context-matched English monologues in which only the trigger utterance varies within a topic, define 10 conditions from turn-allocation rules, and compress inter-word pauses to limit opportunities created by silence. Across five model families, being addressed and silence are far more reliable triggers than false facts or hazards. Frame-level text-token probabilities in Moshi and PersonaPlex are lower for false facts than for Neutral when averaged over the first 2\,s after trigger end. Pauses or permission to interrupt do not close this gap either. Given the floor, Moshi and PersonaPlex answer most direct questions, yet the proportion of non-empty false-fact replies that challenge the claim is only .14--.15, and the proportion of hazard replies that warn of danger is .04--.07. This paper thus identifies a gap in both speech initiation and response content. Closing it requires genuine content understanding and intervention decisions grounded in it.
title: Full-Duplex Speech Models Take the Floor When Asked, Not When Needed
title_translated: 当被要求时，全双工语音模型才开口，而非在需要时
summary_translated: 全双工语音模型能够同时听和说，有望实现始终在线的助手。然而，它们也必须决定何时应该说话。人类听众在被称呼或说话者停止时会发言，也会自主选择纠正错误陈述、补充缺失词汇或警告危险。我们探讨全双工模型是否具备类似行为。为分离说话动机与说话机会，我们构建了语境匹配的英语独白，在同一主题下仅触发话语变化，并定义了10种基于轮次分配规则的条件，压缩词间停顿以限制沉默带来的机会。在五个模型家族中，被称呼和沉默远比错误事实或危险更可靠的触发信号。Moshi和PersonaPlex在触发结束后的前2秒内，对错误事实的帧级文本标记概率低于中性情况。停顿或允许打断也无法缩小这一差距。尽管获得发言权后，Moshi和PersonaPlex能回答大多数直接问题，但挑战错误陈述的非空回复比例仅为0.14–0.15，警告危险的回复比例仅为0.04–0.07。因此，本文揭示了语音发起和回应内容之间的差距。弥合这一差距需要真正的内容理解以及基于理解的干预决策。

summary: Data attribution methods using gradient similarity are widely used to analyze and select training data for large language models, but what gradient similarity actually measures is debated. Some interpret it as identifying task-relevant skills, while other work reports that surface form is the main factor. We resolve this debate for supervised fine-tuning examples by varying task and answer format independently. Specifically, we render benchmarks in different answer formats, such that datasets can share a task without a format or a format without a task. We find that gradient alignment follows the answer format, as benchmark pairs sharing an answer format align strongly (disattenuated cosine near 0.4), while same benchmarks rendered with different answer format classes show no alignment (near 0.0). We demonstrate that this ordering holds from the earliest pretraining checkpoints through post-training, and across model scales and families. We then analyze the released selections of LESS, a gradient-based data selection method for instruction tuning, and find that each target's selections over-represent the target's own answer format. Hence, we demonstrate that gradient-based attribution methods track format similarity more than task semantics, meaning that such methods, as well as the semantic interpretation of the gradient, should be tested on data where answer format and task vary independently for greater robustness and reliability.
title: Form Over Content In Gradient-Based Data Attribution Methods
title_translated: 基于梯度的数据归因方法：形式重于内容
summary_translated: 基于梯度相似性的数据归因方法广泛用于分析和选择大语言模型的训练数据，但其实际衡量内容仍存在争议。一些观点认为它识别任务相关技能，而另一些研究则指出表面形式是主要因素。我们通过独立改变任务和答案格式来解决这一争议。具体而言，我们将基准测试以不同答案格式呈现，使数据集可在无格式或无任务的情况下共享。我们发现，梯度对齐遵循答案格式：共享相同格式的基准对之间对齐性强（去衰减余弦接近0.4），而同一基准使用不同格式类别的对则无对齐（接近0.0）。该规律从最早的预训练检查点到训练后均成立，且跨模型规模和家族一致。随后我们分析了LESS（一种基于梯度的数据选择方法）的公开选择结果，发现每个目标的选择结果过度代表了其自身答案格式。因此，我们证明基于梯度的归因方法更关注格式相似性而非任务语义，这意味着此类方法及其梯度的语义解释应在答案格式与任务独立变化的数据上进行测试，以提升鲁棒性和可靠性。

summary: In mental health care, reasoning over patient journeys is a key task for clinicians. Yet these journeys, encompassing a longitudinal progression of biological, psychological, and social events, are often spread across disparate unstructured text narratives, making temporal recovery challenging. We present CliniCIRCA, a multi-stage LLM framework for Calendar-anchored, Imprecision-aware Reconstruction of Clinical Annals. To our knowledge, CliniCIRCA is the first to temporally classify clinical events across unstructured discharge summaries without event-level timestamps. From 14,882 MIMIC-III mental health admissions, we first construct a benchmark of 52 discharge summaries on which CliniCIRCA produces 15,891 temporally tagged events. After correcting 629 errors based on a clinician-in-the-loop evaluation, we produce verified gold-standard labels. Finally, the corrected timelines drive a temporally grounded summarization stage that compresses each source 1.52 times into a date-grouped chronological record. We then scale the framework to generate 1,000 silver-standard timelines and evaluate them as training data. Compared with zero- and few-shot prompting, instruction tuning generally improves five open-weight models on event extraction, temporal tagging, and summarization across silver and clinician-verified evaluations.
title: CliniCIRCA: A Modular LLM Framework for Constructing Longitudinal Mental Health Patient Journeys from Raw EHR Narratives
title_translated: CliniCIRCA：一种模块化LLM框架，用于从原始电子病历叙述中构建纵向心理健康患者旅程
summary_translated: 在心理健康护理中，对患者历程进行推理是临床医生的关键任务。然而，这些历程涵盖生物、心理和社会事件的长期发展，常分散在不同的非结构化文本叙述中，导致时间恢复困难。我们提出CliniCIRCA，一种多阶段LLM框架，用于日历锚定、误差感知的临床记录重建。据我们所知，CliniCIRCA是首个在无事件级时间戳的非结构化出院摘要中实现临床事件时间分类的方法。基于14,882例MIMIC-III心理健康入院记录，我们首先构建了一个包含52份出院摘要的基准，生成15,891个时间标记事件。经过临床医生参与评估并修正629处错误后，我们生成了经验证的黄金标准标签。最终，修正的时间线驱动一个时间锚定的摘要阶段，将每份源文档压缩1.52倍，形成按日期分组的时序记录。随后，我们将该框架扩展至生成1,000条银标准时间线，并将其作为训练数据进行评估。相比零样本和少样本提示，指令微调在银标准和临床医生验证评估中普遍提升了五种开源模型在事件提取、时间标记和摘要方面的表现。

summary: Model fusion integrates the capabilities from source models into a single target model. As of June 2026, Hugging Face hosts more than 2M models. This growing pool provides a rich base for model reuse and capability integration. Yet existing surveys often cover only separate parts of this space, and they do not provide a unified definition or a systematic taxonomy. This survey defines model fusion and organizes prior work into three levels: parameter-level, representation-level, and behavior-level fusion. We also review related metrics, benchmarks, and applications, summarize current challenges, and identify future directions. Our goal is to provide a clear map of this area and support future work on model fusion. A comprehensive list of papers about model fusion is available at https://github.com/Baicaihaochi/Awesome-Model-Fusion-Survey.
title: From Parameters to Behaviors: A Survey of Model Fusion for Large Language Models
comment: 25 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
title_translated: 从参数到行为：大语言模型模型融合的综述
summary_translated: 模型融合将源模型的能力整合进单一目标模型。截至2026年6月，Hugging Face托管的模型超过200万个。这一不断增长的资源池为模型复用和能力集成提供了丰富基础。然而，现有综述通常仅覆盖该领域的部分方面，且缺乏统一定义和系统性分类。本综述定义了模型融合，并将先前工作组织为三个层次：参数级、表示级和行为级融合。我们还回顾了相关指标、基准和应用，总结了当前挑战，并指明未来方向。我们的目标是为该领域提供清晰的地图，支持未来模型融合研究。关于模型融合的全面论文列表可访问 https://github.com/Baicaihaochi/Awesome-Model-Fusion-Survey。

summary: As model-generated content is increasingly consumed by other model instances in automated workflows, a practically important question arises: can a model embed a signal in natural language that an independent instance of the same model can detect, relying only on shared pre-training and task instructions, without any shared memory or coordination-specific training? We introduce For Your Eyes Only, a cooperative signalling game designed to evaluate this directly. A Sender produces free-form descriptions for two words, one of which is a hidden target; an isolated Receiver must identify it. We evaluate seven contemporary models from four architectural families on 300 word pairs from established psycholinguistic corpora, using the Double-Pass Success Rate to control for output biases. We find that most models struggle to maintain coordination once they are required to avoid detectable signals, while one frontier model retains near-perfect performance even after such filtering. We further show that models can direct this capability toward deliberate misdirection, and that coordination is consistently weaker across architectures than within them.
title: For Your Eyes Only: Evaluating Coordination Between Isolated Language Model Instances
title_translated: 仅供你一人观看：评估孤立语言模型实例间的协作能力
summary_translated: 随着模型生成内容越来越多地被其他模型实例在自动化流程中消费，一个实际重要问题浮现：一个模型能否在自然语言中嵌入信号，使得同一模型的独立实例仅依靠共享的预训练知识和任务指令即可检测到，而无需共享内存或专门的协作训练？我们引入“仅供你一人观看”这一合作信号游戏，直接评估该能力。发送方生成两个词语的自由描述，其中一个为隐藏目标；孤立的接收方需识别出该目标。我们在300组来自公认心理学语言学语料库的词语对上，对来自四个架构家族的七种现代模型进行了评估，采用双遍成功率控制输出偏差。我们发现，大多数模型在被要求避免可检测信号后难以维持协作，而一个前沿模型即使在过滤后仍保持近乎完美的性能。我们进一步表明，模型可将此能力用于故意误导，且跨架构的协作能力始终弱于同架构内部。

summary: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is widely used for multimodal, cross-document question answering. However, building corpus-level graphs is expensive, slow to query, and difficult to maintain. We present TrioRAG, a graph-free multimodal framework that integrates evidence from three complementary signals: the question, the anchor image, and a VLM-enhanced query generated from both. Each signal retrieves independently over a shared multi-vector index of page text and page images, and the results are combined through late fusion. Further, we introduce AutoQA, a multimodal automotive benchmark whose questions are grounded in noisy, web-sourced images rather than clean document-sourced figures. Its questions require reasoning across manuals. We position it as a model-curated testbed rather than a human-validated gold standard. Across three benchmarks, TrioRAG matches or outperforms graph-based systems while reducing total cost and accelerating per-query inference by 1.6-2.3 times. By construction, AutoQA grounds its questions in out-of-corpus web images. In this setting image retrieval reaches only 19.3% document-level recall, while text-derived signals, especially the VLM-enhanced query, keep retrieval robust.
title: Less Is More: Graph-free Multimodal RAG via Multi-signal Late Fusion
title_translated: 少即是多：基于多信号后融合的无图多模态RAG
summary_translated: 基于图的检索增强生成（RAG）广泛应用于多模态跨文档问答。然而，构建语料库级别的图代价高昂、查询速度慢且难以维护。我们提出TrioRAG，一种无图的多模态框架，通过三种互补信号——问题、锚定图像以及由两者生成的VLM增强查询——整合证据。每种信号独立地在共享的多向量索引（包含页面文本和页面图像）上进行检索，并通过后融合方式合并结果。此外，我们引入AutoQA，一个面向多模态汽车领域的基准测试，其问题基于噪声较大的网络来源图像而非干净的文档图像，要求模型在手册间进行推理。我们将该基准定位为由模型自定义的测试环境，而非人类验证的黄金标准。在三个基准测试中，TrioRAG的表现与基于图的系统相当或更优，同时降低了总成本，并使每次查询的推理速度提升1.6至2.3倍。由于设计原因，AutoQA的问题基于语料库外的网络图像。在此设置下，图像检索的文档级召回率仅为19.3%，而文本衍生信号，尤其是VLM增强查询，保持了较强的检索鲁棒性。

summary: Prior work has shown that internal harmfulness representations in large language models vary across risk categories, while sharing a common general harm representation component. This raises a question about the role of the category-specific component beyond general harm representation in LLM safety. To answer this question, we isolate the category-specific component by removing shared general harmfulness representation from each categorical harmfulness representation, yielding a category residual that is orthogonal to general harmfulness at every layer. Using activation steering with category residuals across 11 risk categories in 3 instruction-tuned LLMs, we find that whether category residuals encode harmfulness varies across categories, and that this category-wise pattern is similar across models. Whether category residuals induce refusal also varies across categories, but this category-wise pattern is more model-dependent. We also find that category residuals increase LLMs' downstream internal alignment with shared general harmfulness representation. Together, these findings demonstrate that more fine-grained category residuals should also be considered beyond shared general harmfulness representation to fully understand LLM safety. More broadly, our findings show that even a direction orthogonal to a concept at one layer can contribute to the concept's downstream amplification.
title: The Role of Fine-grained Harm Signals in LLM Safety
title_translated: 细粒度有害信号在大语言模型安全中的作用
summary_translated: 先前研究发现，大型语言模型内部的有害性表征在不同风险类别间存在差异，但共享一个通用有害性表征组件。这引发了一个问题：除了通用有害性表征外，类别特异性组件在LLM安全中扮演什么角色？为回答此问题，我们通过从每个类别有害性表征中移除共享的通用有害性表征，分离出类别残差，该残差在每一层均与通用有害性正交。在三个指令微调的大语言模型中，对11个风险类别使用类别残差进行激活操控，我们发现类别残差是否编码有害性因类别而异，且这种类别模式在不同模型间具有相似性。类别残差是否引发拒绝行为也随类别变化，但这一模式更具模型依赖性。此外，我们发现类别残差增强了LLM下游与共享通用有害性表征的一致性。综合来看，这些发现表明，在全面理解LLM安全时，应将更细粒度的类别残差纳入考量。更广泛地说，我们的研究显示，即使在某一层与某一概念正交的方向，也可能在下游促进该概念的放大。

summary: Full-duplex speech-to-speech (S2S) models provide natural, low-latency conversational interaction and would benefit from the ability to use external tools and complete voice-agent tasks. We propose a frontend-backend architecture where a duplex speech-to-text frontend learns to emit a delegation token and forwards streaming ASR transcripts to a text-based backend LLM for tool calls. Tool-call results from the backend are injected back into the frontend through a lightweight prefill-and-repeat mechanism and then synthesized using streaming TTS to the user. Our approach largely preserves regular duplex turn-taking, interruption handling, and low-latency interaction as it requires minimal modifications to the frontend model. In a single-turn tool-call evaluation, our system achieves 92-97% tool-call recall, competitive tool-call prediction performance, and 81.2% accuracy in rejecting irrelevant calls. When equipped with a larger backend (e.g., Qwen3-235B-A22B), our system achieves competitive results on Full-Duplex-Bench-V3 compared to open and closed source models, and significantly outperforms GPT-realtime-mini and Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct on EVA-Bench. These results demonstrate that backend delegation is an effective and modular approach for combining natural duplex speech interaction with strong agentic tool-call capabilities.
title: A frontend-backend architecture for tool calls in full-duplex speech models
title_translated: 全双工语音模型中工具调用的前后端架构
summary_translated: 全双工语音到语音（S2S）模型提供自然、低延迟的对话交互，若能使用外部工具并完成语音代理任务，将获益良多。我们提出一种前后端架构：双工语音转文本前端学习发出委托令牌，并将流式ASR转录文本传递给基于文本的后端大语言模型以执行工具调用。后端返回的工具调用结果通过轻量级预填充-重复机制注入前端，再经流式TTS合成后反馈给用户。该方法基本保留了常规双工对话的轮次交替、中断处理和低延迟交互特性，仅需对前端模型进行少量修改。在单轮工具调用评估中，系统实现了92%-97%的工具调用召回率，具备竞争力的工具调用预测性能，以及81.2%的无关调用拒绝准确率。当配备更大规模后端模型（如Qwen3-235B-A22B）时，系统在Full-Duplex-Bench-V3上的表现与开源和闭源模型相当，并显著优于GPT-realtime-mini和Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct在EVA-Bench上的表现。这些结果表明，后端委托是一种有效且模块化的方案，可结合自然的双工语音交互与强大的代理工具调用能力。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made remarkable progress in the processing and modeling of many languages. Yet, unlike human multilinguals, they exhibit surprisingly limited cross-lingual knowledge transfer. While this limitation is well documented, its origins during multilingual training remain unclear. We pretrain 360M- and 7B-parameter LLMs and show that poor cross-lingual knowledge generalization emerges during pretraining and persists under standard interventions. To isolate its cause, we employ a controlled bilingual pretraining setting using two copies of the same language, sharing identical text and token segmentation, but mapped to disjoint token spaces. We find that disjoint tokens alone are enough to induce knowledge compartmentalization, even between identical copies of the same language, establishing disjoint token spaces as a fundamental barrier to cross-lingual knowledge generalization. Guided by this understanding, we suggest mapping languages into a shared token space by simple word-wise translation and find it substantially improves cross-lingual knowledge generalization, recovering up to 12.6\% of native-language learning efficiency --- 14$\times$ the baseline.
title: Why Pretraining Fails to Share Cross-Lingual Knowledge
title_translated: 为何预训练无法实现跨语言知识共享
summary_translated: 大型语言模型在多种语言的处理与建模方面取得了显著进展。然而，与人类多语者不同，它们表现出令人惊讶的有限跨语言知识迁移能力。尽管这一局限性已被广泛记录，但其在多语言训练过程中的根源仍不明确。我们对3.6亿和70亿参数的LLM进行预训练，发现较差的跨语言知识泛化能力在预训练阶段即已出现，并在标准干预措施下依然持续存在。为隔离其成因，我们采用受控的双语预训练设置，使用两个相同语言的副本，共享相同的文本和词元分割，但映射到互不重叠的词元空间。我们发现，仅词元空间的分离就足以引发知识隔离，即使是在同一语言的两个副本之间，从而确立了互不重叠的词元空间是跨语言知识泛化的基本障碍。基于这一认识，我们建议通过简单的词级翻译将不同语言映射到共享词元空间，发现这显著提升了跨语言知识泛化能力，恢复了高达12.6%的母语学习效率——是基线水平的14倍。

summary: This paper describes the participation of the YNU-HPCC team in subtask A of task 11, Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion at SemEval-2025. Our best-performing system employs the RoBERTa (Robustly Optimized BERT Approach) model, an improved version of BERT that utilizes the Transformer encoder architecture. We enhanced the output head to allow the model to process one emotion simultaneously. We obtained the official ranking score (0.44), including results from all languages. The entire dataset was translated into English using Google Translate to facilitate subsequent processing. Through probabilistic and attention analyses, we found that (I) a single prediction head performs better than six heads predicting six emotions simultaneously, and (II) training on a uniformly translated English dataset yields better results than using the original dataset. The code is available at: https://github.com/BGWH123/Semeval-2025-task11.
title: YNU-HPCC at SemEval-2025 Task 11: Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Using Multiple Prediction Headers
title_translated: YNU-HPCC参加SemEval-2025任务11：通过多个预测头弥合文本情感差距
summary_translated: 本文介绍了YNU-HPCC团队参与SemEval-2025任务11子任务A的成果。我们表现最佳的系统采用RoBERTa（稳健优化的BERT方法）模型，这是基于Transformer编码器架构的BERT改进版本。我们对输出头进行了增强，使模型能够同时处理一种情绪。我们在所有语言的结果基础上获得了官方排名分数（0.44）。整个数据集通过Google Translate统一翻译为英文，以促进后续处理。通过概率分析和注意力可视化，我们发现：(I) 单一预测头在同时预测六种情绪时表现优于六个独立头分别预测；(II) 在统一翻译的英文数据集上训练的效果优于使用原始数据集。代码可在https://github.com/BGWH123/Semeval-2025-task11获取。

summary: As AI systems evolve into personalized digital companions, a central capability is reasoning over a user's long-term personal history: not merely storing past events, but tracking longitudinal experiences and evolving preferences. Progress here is bottlenecked by evaluation, existing long-term memory benchmarks are largely synthetic and text-only, they overlook the visual records that anchor everyday human memory, lack the authentic and causally connected longitudinal data that real personalization demands, and consequently remain confined to shallow factual recall. We introduce ReaLMem (Real-world Long-term Multimodal Memory), the first benchmark built from authentic multi-year personal visual archives, paired with first-person subjective annotations. ReaLMem evaluates models across three cognitive tiers of increasing difficulty: factual recall, persona inference, and predictive personalization. We further propose ChronoProfiler, a temporal-weighting profiling module that computes temporal stability scores for user attributes and applies them as a salience prior, resolving conflicts among temporally inconsistent preferences and helping models compound multiple co-active preferences in complex personalized decisions. Extensive evaluation of frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and memory systems on ReaLMem reveals predictive personalization as a consistent ceiling, exposes clear performance gaps and bottlenecks between MLLMs and memory systems, and shows that high-quality, temporally informed representations substantially improve personalization. Together, ReaLMem and ChronoProfiler provide an authentic testbed and a simple, effective mechanism for long-term personalization, laying a foundation for future research on lifelong AI companions.
title: To Memories and Beyond: From Remembering to Knowing You across Long-Term Multimodal Personal Archives
title_translated: 从记忆到认知：基于长期多模态个人档案的回忆与自我认知
summary_translated: 随着AI系统演变为个性化的数字伴侣，对用户长期个人历史进行推理的能力成为核心功能：不仅存储过去事件，还需追踪纵向经验与不断演变的偏好。当前进展受限于评估方法，现有长期记忆基准大多为合成数据且仅限文本，忽略了锚定日常人类记忆的视觉记录，缺乏真实且具有因果关联的纵向数据，因而仍局限于浅层事实回忆。我们提出ReaLMem（真实世界长期多模态记忆）基准，首个基于真实多年个人视觉档案构建的基准，并配以第一人称主观标注。ReaLMem在三个认知层级上评估模型：事实回忆、人格推断和预测个性化。我们进一步提出ChronoProfiler，一种时间加权分析模块，计算用户属性的时间稳定性得分并作为显著性先验，解决时间不一致偏好之间的冲突，帮助模型在复杂个性化决策中整合多个共激活偏好。对前沿多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）和记忆系统的广泛评估揭示，预测个性化是持续存在的性能上限，暴露出MLLMs与记忆系统间明显的性能差距与瓶颈，且高质量、时间感知的表征能显著提升个性化效果。ReaLMem与ChronoProfiler共同提供了一个真实测试平台和一种简单有效的长期个性化机制，为未来终身AI伴侣研究奠定基础。

summary: In verifier-style RLVR, group-relative optimization often treats advantage scale as an implementation detail. This paper separates two low-variance cases: sub-resolution jitter that should not become a preference signal, and credible but small cardinal gaps that should be learned without distorting KL calibration. We propose an advantage-scale three-way calibration interface: the same within-group scale denominator simultaneously determines the reward-branch strength, prompt-level batch weight, and the effective KL calibration induced when the reward branch is re-expressed on the original cardinal scale. This interface explains why RLOO / Dr.GRPO can let credible small gaps become KL dominated, whereas GRPO's standard-deviation denominator can amplify tiny gaps without bound. Based on this interface, we further introduce the Reward-Resolution Protocol and MaxNorm-AC, respectively filtering sub-resolution gaps and providing bounded cardinal recovery on credible nonzero gaps. Across dense / MoE architectures and math / code reasoning, MaxNorm-AC improves over the strongest robust-scale baseline while truncating the low-variance inverse-scale tail.
title: Advantage Scale Calibration Imbalance in Group-Relative Optimization under Low-Variance Rewards: Diagnosis and Bounded Recovery
title_translated: 低方差奖励下组相对优化中的优势尺度校准不平衡：诊断与有界恢复
summary_translated: 在验证器风格的RLVR中，组相对优化通常将优势尺度视为实现细节。本文区分了两种低方差情形：不应成为偏好信号的亚分辨率抖动，以及应被学习但不应扭曲KL校准的真实但微小的基数差距。我们提出一种优势尺度三重校准接口：组内相同尺度分母同时决定奖励分支强度、提示级批处理权重，以及当奖励分支在原始基数尺度上重新表达时所诱导的有效KL校准。该接口解释了为何RLOO/Dr.GRPO会使可信的小差距主导KL，而GRPO的标准差分母会无界放大微小差距。基于此接口，我们进一步引入Reward-Resolution Protocol和MaxNorm-AC，分别过滤亚分辨率差距并为可信非零差距提供有界基数恢复。在密集型/MoE架构及数学/代码推理任务中，MaxNorm-AC优于最强的鲁棒尺度基线，同时截断低方差反比例尾部。

summary: Knowledge graphs are usually integrated into question answering by encoding a retrieved subgraph with a graph neural network and fusing it with the language model in the online inference path. The same subgraph is therefore re-encoded from scratch every time a pair is scored, across training epochs, seeds, and evaluation runs, even though the knowledge graph never changes. We ask whether the retrieved knowledge graphs can instead be compiled once, offline, and then accessed as read-only memory. VisKG-LM shows that it can, by decoupling graph encoding from language reasoning. It serializes each retrieved candidate-specific subgraph as Relation-Labeled Paths and renders the result as an image whose two-dimensional layout preserves the branching structure of the paths. Each image is encoded once, offline, and cached for reuse. At inference, the language model contextualizes the question and candidate from text alone, and only its final layer consults the cached visual memory, reading both its global layout and its local relational detail. The graph information thus enters only after the text has been understood. On the test sets of CommonsenseQA, OpenBookQA, and MedQA-USMLE, VisKG-LMimproves over GreaseLM by $1.2$, $0.8$, and $4.3$ points, respectively, while matching or surpassing GraphVis, a $7$B vision-language model, with only about $400$M online parameters. Against a matched text-only control that receives the identical Relation-Labeled Paths, it gains $4.2$, $6.5$, and $5.1$ points across the three benchmarks. These gains show that the complete visual-memory interface adds value beyond path textualization alone and support compiled visual memory as an alternative to online graph propagation.
title: VisKG-LM: Compiling Knowledge Graphs into Visual Memory for Multiple-Choice Question Answering
title_translated: VisKG-LM：将知识图谱编译为视觉记忆以支持多选题问答
summary_translated: 知识图谱通常通过使用图神经网络编码检索到的子图，并在在线推理路径中将其与语言模型融合来集成到问答系统中。因此，同一子图在每次评分时都会从头重新编码，跨越训练周期、随机种子和评估运行，尽管知识图谱本身从未改变。我们提出：是否可以将检索到的知识图谱一次性离线编译，然后作为只读记忆访问？VisKG-LM证明这是可行的，通过解耦图编码与语言推理。它将每个候选特定的子图序列化为关系标记路径，并将其渲染为图像，其二维布局保留路径的分支结构。每张图像仅需离线编码一次并缓存复用。在推理阶段，语言模型仅通过文本理解问题和候选，最终层才查阅缓存的视觉记忆，读取其全局布局和局部关系细节。因此，图信息仅在文本理解之后进入。在CommonsenseQA、OpenBookQA和MedQA-USMLE的测试集上，VisKG-LM分别比GreaseLM提升1.2、0.8和4.3分，同时以约4亿在线参数匹配或超越70亿参数的视觉语言模型GraphVis。与接收相同关系标记路径的纯文本对照组相比，其在三个基准上分别获得4.2、6.5和5.1分的增益。这些提升表明，完整的视觉记忆接口的价值超越路径文本化本身，支持编译式视觉记忆作为在线图传播的替代方案。

summary: Data-driven fine-tuning is widely adopted to enhance reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs) due to its simplicity and efficiency. However, mainstream imitation learning methods that rely exclusively on perfect reasoning trajectories suffer from a Scaling Collapse: when the problem set is limited, increasing positive examples fails to yield continuous improvement. However, during inference, an LLM can not guarantee that every intermediate step is correct and is therefore prone to errors. Once such errors arise, the LLM often struggles to recover and may be further misled by the accumulation of previous mistakes. To address this, we propose Reflective Recovery, a simple yet effective self-supervised approach that transforms failed reasoning attempts into recovery training data. Specifically, we extract initial segments of failed trajectories, concatenate them with prompts, and use them to guide the LLM toward valid solutions. Because these segments from failed trajectories are likely to contain errors, this process teaches models to recognize and correct mistakes during reasoning, enabling recovery from erroneous states without relying on external critics or reward models. Evaluated on extensive benchmarks, Reflective Recovery significantly improves performance. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, it boosts accuracy from 30.0% to 37.5% on AIME 2025 and from 37.6% to 47.8% on Minerva. More importantly, analyses demonstrate that it breaks the scaling collapse barrier and enables models to develop emergent self-correction behaviors, representing a paradigm shift from outcome-oriented memorization to process-oriented reflective reasoning.
title: Reflective Recovery: A Self-Supervised Method for Reasoning by Learning from Mistakes
title_translated: 反思性恢复：通过从错误中学习实现自我监督推理的方法
summary_translated: 数据驱动的微调被广泛用于增强大语言模型（LLMs）的推理能力，因其简单高效。然而，主流依赖完美推理轨迹的模仿学习方法存在‘缩放崩溃’问题：当问题集有限时，增加正样本无法带来持续改进。然而，在推理过程中，LLM无法保证每一步都正确，容易出错。一旦出现错误，LLM往往难以恢复，可能因先前错误的累积而进一步误导。为此，我们提出Reflective Recovery，一种简单而有效的自监督方法，将失败的推理尝试转化为恢复训练数据。具体而言，我们提取失败轨迹的初始片段，将其与提示拼接，用以引导LLM走向有效解。由于这些来自失败轨迹的片段很可能包含错误，该过程教会模型在推理过程中识别并纠正错误，从而在无需外部批评者或奖励模型的情况下实现从错误状态的恢复。在广泛基准上的评估显示，Reflective Recovery显著提升性能。在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B上，其在AIME 2025上的准确率从30.0%提升至37.5%，在Minerva上从37.6%提升至47.8%。更重要的是，分析表明它打破了缩放崩溃的壁垒，使模型发展出涌现的自我修正行为，标志着从结果导向的记忆化向过程导向的反思性推理范式的转变。

summary: In Human-LLM dialogue, follow-up user utterances may implicitly conflict with earlier intents, leading the LLM to misinterpret user needs and generate inappropriate responses. A reliable dialogue system should proactively detect user-side conflicts before generating a response and seek clarification when necessary. However, prior work has largely focused on LLM-side conflicts, leaving user-side conflicts underexplored. To fill this gap, we construct UC-Bench, a human-annotated benchmark for evaluating user-side conflict detection. Preliminary experiments show that existing LLMs struggle with this task, especially when conflicts arise from implicit incompatibilities grounded in dialogue history. To improve lightweight LLMs with limited training data, we investigate data synthesis for user-side conflict detection. Existing synthesis methods do not explicitly model the implicit incompatibilities between historical and current user utterances, making it difficult to capture the evolution of conflicts and to generate reliably labeled implicit conflict samples. We propose SynUC, a constraint-guided synthesis method that represents user-side conflicts in a constraint space and uses the SPEAKING framework to guide traceable constraint transformations. Applying SynUC to WildChat, we construct UC-Data, a user-side conflict training set containing 2,487 samples. On UC-Bench, Qwen3.5-4B trained on UC-Data outperforms larger general-purpose LLMs such as Claude Opus 4.8, as well as the same backbone trained on data synthesized by existing methods.
title: Towards Proactive Detection of User-Side Implicit Conflicts in Human-LLM Dialogue
title_translated: 迈向人类-LLM对话中用户侧隐含冲突的主动检测
summary_translated: 在人类-LLM对话中，后续用户语句可能隐含地与早期意图冲突，导致LLM误解用户需求并生成不当回应。可靠的对话系统应在生成响应前主动检测用户侧冲突，并在必要时寻求澄清。然而，以往研究主要关注LLM侧冲突，对用户侧冲突关注不足。为填补这一空白，我们构建了UC-Bench，一个由人工标注的用户侧冲突检测基准。初步实验表明，现有LLM在此任务上表现不佳，尤其当冲突源于对话历史中的隐含不兼容性时。为提升轻量级LLM在有限训练数据下的表现，我们研究了用户侧冲突检测的数据合成方法。现有合成方法未显式建模历史与当前用户语句间的隐含不兼容性，难以捕捉冲突演化过程，也难以生成可靠标注的隐含冲突样本。我们提出SynUC，一种约束引导的合成方法，将用户侧冲突表示在约束空间中，并利用SPEAKING框架指导可追溯的约束变换。将SynUC应用于WildChat，我们构建了UC-Data，一个包含2,487个样本的用户侧冲突训练集。在UC-Bench上，基于UC-Data训练的Qwen3.5-4B优于更大的通用LLM如Claude Opus 4.8，也优于使用现有方法合成数据训练的同构模型。

summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve high accuracy on established Classical Chinese Poetry benchmarks, it remains challenging to distinguish transferable Linguistic-Aesthetic Reasoning from reliance on familiar pre-training patterns. To address this issue, we introduce Neo-Classic, an evaluation benchmark that combines a constructionist Out-of-Sample (OOS) dataset with a suite of reverse understanding probes. Unlike traditional benchmarks that rely on verification or generation over historical corpora, Neo-Classic comprises strictly metrical poetry authored by contemporary experts, reducing the possibility of direct retrieval. We evaluate state-of-the-art models, including Qwen3-Max, Gemini-3-Pro, and DeepSeek-V3.2, across five behavioral probes designed to test hierarchical constraint satisfaction. Our results reveal two primary limitations. First, a performance gap of 20 to 50 percent emerges when models transition from historical to contemporary texts. Second, models exhibit substantial difficulties in discourse-level ordering tasks, with standard accuracy remaining low (0 to 13 percent). Although expert-level guidance improves the performance of reasoning-enhanced models to 36 percent, a notable gap with human experts persists. These findings suggest that while current LLMs capture local formal patterns, they struggle with global hierarchical planning required for robust Linguistic-Aesthetic Reasoning.
title: Neo-Classic: A Benchmark for Evaluating Linguistic-Aesthetic Reasoning in Classical Chinese Poetry
comment: Published in the Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers), 2026
title_translated: Neo-Classic：评估古典汉诗语言美学推理的基准
summary_translated: 尽管大语言模型（LLMs）在现有的古典汉诗基准测试中表现出高准确率，但仍难以区分可迁移的语言美学推理与对预训练模式的依赖。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Neo-Classic，一个结合建构主义的样本外（OOS）数据集和一系列逆向理解探测器的评估基准。与依赖历史语料库验证或生成的传统基准不同，Neo-Classic包含由当代专家创作的严格格律诗歌，降低了直接检索的可能性。我们在五个行为探测任务上评估了包括Qwen3-Max、Gemini-3-Pro和DeepSeek-V3.2在内的先进模型，以测试其层次约束满足能力。结果揭示出两个主要局限：首先，当模型从历史文本转向当代文本时，性能差距达到20%至50%；其次，模型在话语层面排序任务上表现极差，标准准确率仅为0%至13%。尽管专家指导使增强推理模型的表现提升至36%，但与人类专家之间仍存在显著差距。这些发现表明，当前LLMs虽能捕捉局部形式模式，但在实现稳健语言美学推理所需的全局层次规划方面仍存在困难。

summary: Empirical legal scholarship increasingly treats judicial text as data, and much of it still runs on sparse, interpretable pipelines -- TF-IDF features and linear classifiers -- because the textual feature is often the object of study, not merely a means to a prediction. Yet these pipelines inherit a chain of preprocessing defaults from mid-century information retrieval that were never validated against classification accuracy, the most entrenched being stopword removal. This study introduces an exhaustive single-word ablation that measures a preprocessing step's effect directly against the downstream objective, and applies it to stopword removal as the hardest case to dislodge. Matching Supreme Court Database labels to Caselaw Access Project opinion texts, it examines two binary tasks that bracket F1 headroom, ideological direction (no-removal baseline F1 ~ 0.68) and constitutional versus non-constitutional law type (~ 0.92), across 7,668 and 7,001 opinions. For each task the analysis approximates the best stoplist any expert could build, removing each of roughly 18,500 candidate words and measuring the effect directly. Three findings follow: generic stoplists in common use fall below the no-removal baseline in every test; even optimized stoplists are statistically indistinguishable from removing nothing; and meta-models trained on word-level features cannot predict which removals help, so list curation has nothing to target. The method generalizes to any inherited preprocessing default, and the result is a caution specific to interpretable legal text-as-data: a step that silently reshapes which features a model sees can distort the very doctrinal and ideological signal such research exists to recover. Leaving stopwords in place is a question of measurement validity.
title: Stop Removing Stopwords: How an Inherited Preprocessing Default Distorts Legal Text-as-Data
title_translated: 不要删除停用词：继承的预处理默认值如何扭曲法律文本作为数据的分析
summary_translated: 实证法律研究越来越多地将司法文本视为数据，且许多研究仍采用稀疏、可解释的处理流程——如TF-IDF特征和线性分类器——因为文本特征本身常是研究对象，而不仅是预测工具。然而，这些流程继承了20世纪中期信息检索中的预处理默认设置，这些设置从未经过分类准确率的验证，其中最根深蒂固的是停用词删除。本研究引入了一种全面的单字消融实验，直接衡量预处理步骤对下游目标的影响，并以停用词删除作为最难改变的案例进行分析。通过将最高法院数据库标签匹配到Caselaw Access Project的判例文本，研究考察了两个二元任务：意识形态方向（无删除基线F1约0.68）和宪法性与非宪法性法律类型（约0.92），涵盖7,668和7,001份判例。针对每个任务，分析近似任何专家可能构建的最佳停用词列表，逐一移除约18,500个候选词并直接测量影响。研究发现：通用停用词列表在所有测试中均低于无删除基线；即使优化后的停用词列表在统计上也无法与不删除任何词区分开；基于词级特征训练的元模型无法预测哪些删除有助于性能，因此词表维护缺乏明确目标。该方法可推广至任何继承的预处理默认值，结果对可解释的法律文本作为数据研究提出警示：一个悄然重塑模型所见特征的步骤，可能扭曲研究本欲恢复的教义与意识形态信号。保留停用词是一个测量有效性的关键问题。

summary: Misinformation detection tools often rely on binary true and false classifications or models trained on historical examples, limiting their usefulness when novel misleading narratives emerge. Here, we present FakeSpotter, a content- and strategy-agnostic tool designed to estimate the viral misinformation risk of textual content by measuring structural fingerprints of misinformation rather than directly adjudicating truthfulness. FakeSpotter operationalizes a theory-driven framework across linguistic, narrative, logical, and critical-thinking dimensions, using repeated LLM assessments and domain-specific logistic regression classifiers for short and long texts. In a labelled corpus of 764 texts from social media and FakeNewsNet, FakeSpotter achieved macro F1 scores of 0.788 for short texts and 0.793 for long texts on a held-out test set. FakeSpotter's interpretive layer provides explainable outputs through feature-based scores, signal agreement, and a caution index, and can be used for social listening. These findings suggest that identifying the structural fingerprints of misinformation can support early, explainable, and human-supervised assessment of potentially viral misinformation.
title: FakeSpotter: A content and strategy agnostic Viral Misinformation Detection Tool
title_translated: FakeSpotter：一种内容与策略无关的病毒式虚假信息检测工具
summary_translated: 虚假信息检测工具通常依赖于真假二元分类或基于历史案例训练的模型，这使得在新型误导性叙事出现时其适用性受限。本文提出FakeSpotter，一种内容与策略无关的工具，旨在通过测量虚假信息的结构指纹而非直接判断真实性，来评估文本内容的病毒式虚假信息风险。FakeSpotter在语言、叙事、逻辑和批判性思维维度上实施理论驱动的框架，利用重复的LLM评估和领域特定的逻辑回归分类器分别处理短文本和长文本。在包含764条来自社交媒体和FakeNewsNet的标注语料库上，FakeSpotter在保留测试集上的宏平均F1得分分别为0.788（短文本）和0.793（长文本）。其可解释层提供基于特征的评分、信号一致性以及警告指数，支持社交监听。这些发现表明，识别虚假信息的结构指纹可支持早期、可解释且人工监督的潜在病毒式虚假信息评估。

summary: Generative AI (GenAI) applications have achieved rapid consumer adoption, yet little large-scale research examines user-perceived quality, trust, and adoption barriers. We present one of the first cross-application analyses of app store reviews for six major GenAI applications (ChatGPT, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, DeepSeek, and Perplexity), comprising 17,012 English-language reviews from Google Play and the Apple App Store. We combine BERTopic topic modeling with RoBERTa sentiment classification and evaluate cross-application differences using chi-square, Kruskal-Wallis, and multinomial logistic regression with Bonferroni correction. Both components are validated against human coding using a stratified sample of 300 reviews. Results show that negative sentiment concentrates in advertising (91%), authentication (89%), server reliability (83%), and subscription pricing (73%). Sentiment differs significantly across applications, with Claude exhibiting the highest negative sentiment (47.7%) alongside a strongly enthusiastic user base, indicating statistically significant polarization. These findings are robust despite unequal review counts across applications. As exploratory observations, a subset of DeepSeek reviews raised geopolitical and data privacy concerns related to its Chinese origin, while a proposed Trust Friction Score summarizes application-specific trust and usability barriers into interpretable dimensions. The study provides validated and actionable evidence on user trust, usability, and adoption barriers in consumer generative AI applications.
title: What Users Think of Generative AI: A Cross-Platform NLP Analysis of Trust and Friction in App Store Reviews
