title_translated: 用户如何看待生成式AI：跨平台NLP分析应用商店评论中的信任与摩擦
summary_translated: 生成式AI（GenAI）应用已实现快速消费者普及，但尚缺乏大规模研究探讨用户感知的质量、信任及采纳障碍。我们呈现了针对六款主流GenAI应用（ChatGPT、Gemini、Microsoft Copilot、Claude、DeepSeek和Perplexity）的首个跨应用分析，涵盖来自Google Play和Apple App Store的17,012条英文评论。我们结合BERTopic主题建模与RoBERTa情感分类，并使用卡方检验、Kruskal-Wallis检验及带Bonferroni校正的多项式逻辑回归评估跨应用差异。两项组件均通过分层抽样的300条评论与人工编码进行验证。结果显示，负面情绪集中于广告（91%）、认证（89%）、服务器可靠性（83%）和订阅定价（73%）。不同应用间情感差异显著，Claude表现出最高负面情绪（47.7%），同时拥有高度热情的用户群体，表明存在统计显著的两极分化。这些发现即使在各应用评论数量不均的情况下依然稳健。作为探索性观察，部分DeepSeek评论提及与其中国背景相关的地缘政治和数据隐私担忧；此外，提出的“信任摩擦评分”将应用特定的信任与可用性障碍归纳为可解释维度。该研究为消费级生成式AI应用中的用户信任、可用性和采纳障碍提供了经验证且可操作的证据。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) encode rich stylistic structure in their hidden activations, but discovering which stylistic dimensions are salient for a given prompt typically requires supervised contrastive data. We present a training-free, prompt-conditional alternative: we repeatedly sample completions of a single prompt at elevated temperature, apply Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to the pooled hidden activations, and label the resulting axes automatically from the pole generations. We validate the discovered axes against 245 human-elicited stylistic annotations in a two-phase study. On our strongest model (Qwen-3.5-4B-Instruct), the top two axes match spontaneously requested human dimensions with 72.8% precision and 43.6% macro-recall, and 75.6% of validity ratings judge the axes' polar generations accurate to their labels, with 90.9% adjacent inter-annotator agreement. Discoverability is strongly model-dependent: both Qwen models and Llama-3.2-3B expose human-salient axes, while DeepSeek-7B-Chat drops to 35.3% precision, its leading components dominated by structural rather than stylistic variance. Simple PCA over a model's own decoding variance is thus an effective, low-cost probe of stylistic structure in LLM representations, one that also exposes sharp cross-model differences in how that structure is organized.
title: Sampling Reveals Style: Unsupervised, Training-Free Discovery of Prompt-Conditional Stylistic Axes in LLM Activations
title_translated: 采样揭示风格：无监督、免训练发现LLM激活中提示条件化的风格轴
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）在其隐藏激活中编码了丰富的风格结构，但发现特定提示下哪些风格维度具有显著性通常需要监督对比数据。我们提出一种免训练、提示条件化的替代方法：对单一提示反复以高温采样生成内容，对合并的隐藏激活应用主成分分析（PCA），并自动从极点生成中标注所得轴。我们在两阶段研究中将发现的轴与245个人类诱发的风格标注进行验证。在最强模型（Qwen-3.5-4B-Instruct）上，前两个轴以72.8%的精确率和43.6%的宏召回率匹配自发请求的人类风格维度，75.6%的有效性评分认为极点生成与标签准确对应，相邻标注者间一致性达90.9%。可发现性强烈依赖于模型：Qwen系列和Llama-3.2-3B均暴露人类关注的风格轴，而DeepSeek-7B-Chat则降至35.3%精确率，其主导成分由结构而非风格方差主导。因此，对模型自身解码方差进行简单PCA是一种有效且低成本的LLM表示中风格结构探测方法，同时也揭示了不同模型在组织此类结构上的显著差异。

summary: Subliminal learning shows that language models can transmit a hidden trait through outputs that appear unrelated to it. One proposed explanation, token entanglement, links animal and number tokens through the model's output vocabulary. Yet existing measurements answer different questions: whether outputs co-vary, fixed output vectors align, an answer can be read from a hidden state, or that state causally controls the answer. We measure each separately in a fixed animal-number prompting protocol. From Llama-3.1-8B to 70B, fixed output-vector similarity predicts behavior less well: the paired mean correlation change is -0.080 (95% CI [-0.127, -0.035]). A fixed output-head readout shows no resolved change in normalized depth AUC. To test control, we copy the temporary answer-position state from one number prompt into another at five depths and measure which prompt the final animal score follows. Donor-control AUC rises from 0.254 to 0.540, a paired change of +0.286 (95% CI [+0.272, +0.300]), with increases for all 18 concepts. The contrast remains with exactly eight transformer blocks remaining, while specificity and identity controls remain small or exact. In two Qwen models, scoring every digit in sequence does not recover the positive one-token association. Per-token averaging instead creates a positive pooled association that disappears after controlling number width, revealing a length confound. Thus, fixed geometry, observational readability, causal timing, and multi-token measurement are distinct properties of this frozen prompting channel. They constrain token-level explanations but do not identify the mechanism of training-time trait transfer.
title: Subliminal Prompting Beyond Static Geometry: Causal Depth and Multi-Token Confounds
title_translated: 超越静态几何的隐性提示：因果深度与多标记混淆
summary_translated: 隐性学习表明，语言模型可以通过看似无关的输出传递隐藏特征。一种解释是标记纠缠，即通过模型输出词汇将动物和数字标记关联起来。然而现有测量方法回答的问题各不相同：输出是否共变、固定输出向量是否对齐、答案能否从隐藏状态读取，或该状态是否因果控制答案。我们在固定的动物-数字提示协议中分别测量这些因素。从 Llama-3.1-8B 到 70B，固定输出向量相似性对行为的预测能力下降：成对均值相关性变化为 -0.080（95% 置信区间 [-0.127, -0.035]）。固定输出头读出显示归一化深度 AUC 无显著变化。为测试控制效果，我们将一个数字提示中的临时答案位置状态复制到另一个提示中，在五个深度上测量最终动物得分所遵循的提示。捐赠者-控制 AUC 从 0.254 上升至 0.540，成对变化为 +0.286（95% 置信区间 [+0.272, +0.300]），所有 18 个概念均呈现上升趋势。即使仅保留八个 Transformer 块，这种对比依然存在，而特异性与身份控制仍保持较小或精确。在两个 Qwen 模型中，按顺序评分每个数字无法恢复正向单标记关联；而逐标记平均则产生正向聚合关联，但在控制数字宽度后消失，揭示了长度混淆。因此，固定几何、观测可读性、因果时间与多标记测量是这一冻结提示通道的不同属性。它们限制了标记级解释，但并未识别训练期间特征传递的机制。

summary: Ambivalence and hesitancy (A/H) are affective states in which individuals express contradictory signals across facial, vocal, and linguistic channels. Automatically recognising A/H in clinical videos requires detecting cross-modal disagreement -- the signal that standard fusion methods suppress. Based on the conflict-aware multimodal fusion framework of Bekhouche et al., we present the Modality Discrepancy Transformer (MDT). MDT enriches the original 6-token design to a 9-token representation comprising three modality embeddings, three absolute-difference features, and three Hadamard-product discrepancy features learned through linear projections. These nine tokens undergo Transformer self-attention, with FiLM-based text-conditioned modulation and LoRA fine-tuning as core architectural components. A text-guided late fusion branch blends a text-only auxiliary head with the full multimodal output at inference. On the BAH dataset from the 3rd ABAW Challenge, MDT achieves 0.7408 Macro F1 on the labelled test split and 0.7368 on the private leaderboard, outperforming the strongest published baseline by over 10 points while training in under 20 minutes on a single GPU.
title: Modality Discrepancy Transformer for Ambivalence and Hesitancy Recognition
title_translated: 用于矛盾与犹豫识别的模态差异Transformer
summary_translated: 矛盾与犹豫（A/H）是个体在面部、语音和语言通道中表达相互矛盾信号的情感状态。在临床视频中自动识别 A/H 需要检测跨模态不一致——这是标准融合方法所抑制的信号。基于 Bekhouche 等人提出的冲突感知多模态融合框架，我们提出模态差异Transformer（MDT）。MDT 将原始的6标记设计扩展为包含三个模态嵌入、三个绝对差特征和三个哈达玛积差异特征的9标记表示，这些特征通过线性投影学习。这九个标记经过Transformer自注意力处理，核心架构包括基于FiLM的文本条件调制和LoRA微调。一个文本引导的晚期融合分支在推理时将仅文本的辅助头与完整的多模态输出融合。在第三届ABAW挑战赛的BAH数据集上，MDT在标注测试集上达到0.7408的宏F1，在私有排行榜上达到0.7368，优于最强公开基线超过10分，且在单张GPU上训练时间不足20分钟。

summary: Coding agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot manipulation: a language model writes the robot controller as a program, and agents built in this way now operate robots without robot-specific training.Whether this paradigm is also safe, however, has not been asked. We evaluate coding agent under a safety constraint, where each task pairs a manipulation goal with an obstacle the robot must not touch. The agent pursues the goal but collides with the obstacle in most cases, treating task completion as its sole objective while neglecting safety. The agent reasons about the obstacle in its traces, and the prompt already forbids touching it, so neither perception nor instruction is at fault; the fault lies in the planning, where the stated constraint never becomes a priority. By decomposing manipulation into a route phase and a contact-rich moment, we locate the source of the failure. Along the route, the model cannot prioritize the safety constraint, having no notion of a clearing route and none of replanning once a chosen route becomes infeasible. At the contact, it is unaware that contact execution is bounded by the same constraint. To close this gap, we present SafeHarness, which equips the model with two obstacle-aware harnesses that enable it to prioritize the safety constraint. Obstacle-aware route planning grounds the objects as bounding boxes and draws candidate routes over them as sequences of waypoints. The agent then plans a route in advance, verifies it, replans when necessary, and only then executes it. Obstacle-aware contact execution instead selects the contact position so that the contact itself avoids the obstacle. SafeHarness attains 71.9% task success and 87.5% collision avoidance, surpassing the previous SOTA by 6.5% and 27.0%, respectively. These results are $2.3\times$ and $1.5\times$ those of the same agent without harnesses.
title: Coding Agents with an Obstacle-Aware Harness for Safe Robot Manipulation
title_translated: 具备障碍物感知约束的编码代理实现安全机器人操作
summary_translated: 编码代理已成为机器人操作的一种有前景范式：语言模型编写机器人控制器作为程序，此类代理无需针对特定机器人进行训练即可运行。然而，这种范式是否安全尚未被探讨。我们评估了编码代理在安全约束下的表现，其中每个任务都包含一个操作目标和一个机器人必须避免触碰的障碍物。代理在多数情况下追求目标但发生碰撞，将其任务完成视为唯一目标，忽视了安全性。代理在其推理轨迹中会思考障碍物，且提示已禁止触碰，因此问题不在感知或指令层面；根本原因在于规划阶段，即明确的安全约束从未成为优先事项。通过将操作分解为路径阶段和接触密集时刻，我们定位了失败根源。在路径阶段，模型无法优先考虑安全约束，既没有清除路径的概念，也无法在选定路径不可行时重新规划。在接触阶段，它未意识到接触执行受同一约束限制。为弥补这一差距，我们提出SafeHarness，为模型配备两种障碍物感知约束，使其能够优先考虑安全约束。障碍物感知路径规划将物体建模为边界框，并在上面绘制候选路径作为一系列航点。代理提前规划路径、验证路径、必要时重规划，然后才执行。障碍物感知接触执行则选择接触位置，使接触本身避开障碍物。SafeHarness实现了71.9%的任务成功率和87.5%的碰撞避免率，分别优于之前最先进方法6.5%和27.0%。这些结果分别是未使用约束的同一代理的2.3倍和1.5倍。

summary: Coding harnesses shape how autonomous coding agents translate model capabilities into long-horizon software-engineering performance, yet existing work typically evaluates harnesses as monolithic systems, leaving the effectiveness of individual components unclear. To enable component-level comparisons, we study this question with a lightweight coding harness whose execution loop is fixed while three components are varied: planning, action space, and context management. Across four models evaluated on SWE-Bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.1, we evaluate 176 matched settings spanning five context-management strategies, four context-window budgets, and targeted ablations of planning and action space. We find that: (1) Context management becomes increasingly valuable as the context-window budget tightens, with most of its benefit coming from preventing context-overflow failures. (2) Staging rule-based elision before LLM-based summarization provides the strongest overall efficiency among the context-management strategies, whereas making elided content recoverable adds machinery that models rarely use and yields no accuracy gain. (3) Planning shifts from an accuracy scaffold for weaker models to a cost saver for stronger models, with little change in accuracy. (4) Predefined tools improve performance for models with weaker bash proficiency, whereas bash-capable models can operate effectively with a bash-only interface and achieve substantially lower cost, especially on command-line-centric tasks. Trajectory-level analysis explains these effects: context management extends execution trajectories without substantially altering agent behavior, planning changes where trajectories stop, and the action space changes the granularity at which code is written. These findings inform model- and budget-aware harness design and provide a modular framework for evaluating future harness components.
title: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents
title_translated: 编码代理约束设计的实证研究
summary_translated: 编码约束决定了自主编码代理如何将模型能力转化为长周期软件工程性能，但现有工作通常将约束视为整体系统进行评估，导致各组件的有效性不明确。为支持组件级比较，我们研究了一个轻量级编码约束，其执行循环固定，而三个组件（规划、动作空间、上下文管理）可变。在四个模型上对SWE-Bench Verified和Terminal-Bench 2.1进行评估，共涵盖176组匹配设置，涉及五种上下文管理策略、四种上下文窗口预算以及对规划和动作空间的针对性消融实验。我们发现：(1) 随着上下文窗口预算收紧，上下文管理的价值日益提升，其大部分收益来自防止上下文溢出失败；(2) 在上下文管理策略中，先进行基于规则的剔除再进行LLM摘要提供最强的整体效率，而使剔除内容可恢复虽增加复杂性，但模型极少使用且未带来准确率提升；(3) 规划对较弱模型而言是准确性的支撑，对较强模型则是成本节约手段，准确率变化不大；(4) 预定义工具能提升弱bash能力模型的表现，而具备bash能力的模型仅用bash接口即可有效运行，并在以命令行为中心的任务中实现显著更低的成本。轨迹级分析解释了这些现象：上下文管理延长执行轨迹但不显著改变代理行为，规划改变轨迹终止位置，动作空间改变代码编写的粒度。这些发现为模型和预算感知的约束设计提供了指导，并构建了一个模块化框架以评估未来约束组件。

summary: Agent trajectories record what an agent does and what happens next. Yet standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) applies loss only to agent-authored action tokens, using environment observations as context but not as prediction targets. We ask whether this convention provides the best initialization for subsequent reinforcement learning. We introduce ActObs, which also supervises the observation tokens already present in each trajectory. Although deployed agents never generate observations, learning to predict them encourages the policy to model action consequences without adding data, parameters, sequence tokens, or forward passes. The methods perform similarly after SFT but diverge after GRPO. On Qwen3-4B, GRPO from ActObs achieves higher pass@k at every evaluated sampling budget than its action-only counterpart on Terminal-Bench 2.0. On Qwen3-8B, it trades some pass@1 reliability for higher pass@k (+3.4 pp at pass@16) and solves more distinct tasks. The advantage extends to cross-domain code editing on aider-polyglot (+4.2 pp at pass@1 at 4B), whose tasks are unseen during SFT and RL. ActObs retains more entropy during RL while requiring less policy movement, leaving the final policy closer to its SFT initialization. Our analysis traces this difference to SFT: action and observation gradients rapidly become orthogonal, while action-only training leaves a large residual observation gradient and degrades environment prediction below the base model. Joint supervision prevents this one-sided specialization, preserving consequence prediction and preparing the policy for downstream exploration.
title: Don't Mask the Environment: Observation Supervision Changes How Agents Explore Under RL
title_translated: 不要遮蔽环境：观察监督如何改变强化学习中的探索行为
summary_translated: 代理轨迹记录了代理的行为及其后续结果。然而，标准的监督微调（SFT）仅对代理生成的动作标记施加损失，将环境观察作为上下文而非预测目标。我们探讨这一惯例是否为后续强化学习提供了最佳初始化。我们引入ActObs，也对轨迹中已存在的观察标记进行监督。尽管部署的代理从不生成观察，但学习预测它们可促使策略在不增加数据、参数、序列标记或前向传播的情况下建模动作后果。SFT后两种方法表现相似，但在GRPO后出现分歧。在Qwen3-4B上，从ActObs开始的GRPO在Terminal-Bench 2.0的所有采样预算下均优于仅动作监督的版本。在Qwen3-8B上，它以部分pass@1可靠性为代价，获得更高的pass@k（pass@16时+3.4个百分点），并解决更多不同任务。该优势延伸至跨域代码编辑任务aider-polyglot（4B模型下pass@1提升4.2个百分点），其任务在SFT和RL阶段均未见过。ActObs在RL过程中保持更高熵，同时减少策略移动，使最终策略更接近其SFT初始化。我们的分析指出这一差异源于SFT：动作与观察梯度迅速正交，而仅动作训练留下较大的残留观察梯度，导致环境预测性能低于基础模型。联合监督防止了这种单边专业化，保留了后果预测能力，为下游探索做好准备。

summary: Allen's interval algebra is a qualitative calculus for temporal relations, but its thirteen base relations are crisp predicates over exact interval boundaries. This is inadequate for temporal information from language, perception, databases, or uncertain histories, where times, durations, and boundaries are uncertain and expressions such as "just before" or "roughly during" have graded meaning. We develop the probabilistic Allen algebra (PAA): a generative and complete extension in which relation probabilities are derived from distributions over interval boundaries rather than assigned as scores. Time points are Gaussian; intervals have Gaussian midpoints and truncated-Gaussian durations. Every relation is a boundary-ordering predicate in one common probability space: point-point relations reduce to error functions, and point-interval and interval-interval relations to multivariate Gaussian orthant probabilities induced by linear inequalities. Contact relations (meets, starts, finishes, equals) receive positive measure through a tolerance band, and under a single tolerance the thirteen relations form a true partition that recovers crisp Allen as the tolerance vanishes. The construction derives Allen's taxonomy rather than positing it: coarse predicates such as precedence, overlap, and containment are unions of leaves whose probabilities are leaf sums, and this hierarchy is preserved as intervals collapse to points and thirteen relations reduce to five and then three. Each relation further decomposes into correlation-aware temporal primitives in the spirit of CIDOC CRM. The algebra is scale-invariant and separates graded expressions such as "shortly before" from contact relations. All results are Monte-Carlo validated and shipped as an open, tested Python package.
title: PAA: The Probabilistic Allen Algebra: A Generative and Complete Probabilistic Extension of Allen's Interval Relations

title_translated: PAA：概率Allen代数：Allen区间关系的概率生成与完备扩展
summary_translated: Allen区间代数是一种时间关系的定性演算，但其十三个基本关系是基于精确区间边界的清晰谓词。这在来自语言、感知、数据库或不确定历史的时间信息中不足为据，因为时间、持续时间和边界都是不确定的，诸如“刚刚之前”或“大致期间”等表达具有程度意义。我们提出了概率Allen代数（PAA）：一种生成性和完备的扩展，其中关系概率由区间边界的分布推导而来，而非作为评分分配。时间点为高斯分布；区间具有高斯中点和截断高斯持续时间。每个关系都是同一概率空间中的边界顺序谓词：点-点关系简化为误差函数，点-区间和区间-区间关系则转化为由线性不等式诱导的多元高斯象限概率。接触关系（相遇、开始、结束、相等）通过容忍带获得正测度，在单一容忍度下，十三个关系形成真正的划分，并在容忍度趋近于零时恢复清晰的Allen关系。该构造推导出Allen的分类体系，而非假设它：粗粒度谓词如先于、重叠和包含是叶节点的并集，其概率为叶节点概率之和，且当区间坍缩为点时，十三个关系逐步简化为五个再至三个，这一层次结构得以保持。每个关系进一步分解为考虑相关性的时序原语，体现CIDOC CRM的精神。该代数具有尺度不变性，并将‘短暂之前’等程度表达与接触关系分离。所有结果均经蒙特卡洛验证，并以开源、经过测试的Python包形式发布。

summary: Full-consensus rates are often treated as indicators of collective cognition, yet depend on how participation and final states are operationalized. We replayed 100 held-out human Wason groups with matched large language model (LLM) agent groups, seeding one belief-anchored agent per participant's pre-discussion answer and scoring agents and people with the same code. Across human scoring definitions, estimates ranged from 24.0% to 57.0%; about one fifth of participants never posted, whereas agents almost always did. Agent groups remained more consensual in two post-unblinding sensitivity analyses: the submit-based comparison (n = 98) yielded gaps of 34.0 and 43.9 percentage points for chat and reasoning modes, and the participation-matched comparison (n = 45) yielded gaps of 34.1 and 44.4 points. These complementary routes reduced different measurement asymmetries yet converged within 0.5 percentage points. The gap persisted without early stopping and under a reparameterization removing the memorizable answer; reasoning-mode groups then agreed nearly unanimously, mostly on incorrect answers. Simulated consensus did not track collective accuracy, and belief-anchored agent groups were biased estimators of the human group-outcome distribution in this setting. These analyses provide a scoring-explicit basis for assessing simulated-group estimates of human deliberative outcomes.
title: Language-model groups overstate consensus when replaying human deliberation on a reasoning task

title_translated: 语言模型群体在重演人类推理任务讨论时夸大共识
summary_translated: 全共识率常被视为集体认知的指标，但其依赖于参与和最终状态的操作化定义。我们使用与100组人类Wason小组匹配的大语言模型（LLM）代理组进行了重演实验，为每位参与者讨论前的答案设置一个信念锚定的代理，并采用相同的评分代码对代理和人类进行评分。在不同的人类评分定义下，估计值介于24.0%到57.0%之间；约五分之一的参与者从未发帖，而代理几乎总是会发言。在两次去盲敏感性分析中，代理组仍表现出更高的共识度：基于提交的比较（n=98）在聊天模式和推理模式下分别产生34.0和43.9个百分点的差距；参与匹配的比较（n=45）则分别产生34.1和44.4个百分点的差距。这两种互补路径缓解了不同的测量不对称性，但结果在0.5个百分点内收敛。即使在无早期停止和移除可记忆答案参数化的情况下，差距依然存在；此时推理模式下的代理组几乎一致同意，但多数为错误答案。模拟共识并未追踪集体准确性，且信念锚定的代理组在此情境下是对人类群体结果分布的有偏估计。这些分析为评估模拟群体对人类讨论结果的估计提供了明确的评分基础。

summary: FarmerChat is Digital Green's AI-powered agricultural advisory assistant for smallholder farmers, who access it in their own language through text, voice, or photographs. Voice is a critical channel for this population, yet field-recorded speech is challenging for general-purpose automatic speech recognition (ASR) because recordings frequently contain machinery noise, background media, competing speakers, and domain-specific agricultural vocabulary. These conditions disproportionately affect crop, pest, chemical, and quantity terms that carry the meaning of a farmer's query.   We present a modular, model-agnostic pipeline for improving ASR quality in FarmerChat without fine-tuning or replacing the underlying ASR model. The pipeline combines gated audio enhancement, speaker diarization and target-speaker selection, ASR, domain-aware correction using a weighted agricultural lexicon, and a quality gate for detecting unreliable transcripts. Only the diarization stage is fine-tuned; all other stages use off-the-shelf models behind common interfaces.   We evaluate the pipeline on human-annotated FarmerChat recordings in Hindi, Telugu, and Odia using word error rate (WER) and a domain-weighted error rate that gives greater importance to agricultural terminology. The largest improvements occur on multi-speaker recordings, where target-speaker selection prevents competing speech from entering the transcript. Across the full corpus, the pipeline reduces WER by 16-23% relative on three cloud ASR models and by 5% on an on-device model. On multi-speaker recordings, the reductions are 32-42% for the cloud models and 16% for the on-device model. All reported reductions are statistically significant. These results show that targeted preprocessing, speaker selection, and domain-aware post-processing can substantially improve agricultural speech transcription while preserving the underlying ASR model.
title: Model-Agnostic and Language-Agnostic Voice Pipeline Improvement for the Agriculture Domain
title_translated: 面向农业领域的模型无关与语言无关语音管道改进
summary_translated: FarmerChat是Digital Green推出的AI驱动的农业咨询助手，小农户可通过文本、语音或照片以自身语言访问。语音是该人群的关键渠道，但实地录制的语音对通用自动语音识别（ASR）构成挑战，因为录音常包含机械噪声、背景媒体、多人对话以及领域特定的农业词汇。这些条件尤其影响作物、害虫、化学品和数量术语，而这些正是农民查询的核心含义。我们提出了一种模块化、模型无关的语音处理管道，可在不微调或替换底层ASR模型的前提下提升FarmerChat的ASR质量。该管道结合了门控音频增强、说话人分离与目标说话人选择、ASR、基于加权农业词典的领域感知纠错，以及用于检测不可靠转录的质量门。仅说话人分离阶段进行微调；其余所有阶段均使用通用接口上的现成模型。我们在Hindi、Telugu和Odia语的FarmerChat人工标注录音上评估该管道，使用词错误率（WER）和更重视农业术语的领域加权错误率。最大改进出现在多说话人录音中，目标说话人选择有效防止了竞争性语音进入转录。在整个语料库中，该管道使三种云ASR模型的WER相对降低16%-23%，使本地设备模型降低5%。在多说话人录音中，云模型的降幅为32%-42%，本地模型为16%。所有报告的降低均具有统计显著性。结果表明，针对性的预处理、说话人选择和领域感知后处理可显著提升农业语音转录质量，同时保留底层ASR模型。

summary: Reasoning-based reranking with Large Language Models (LLMs) has shown promising improvements in text ranking. However, current methods predominantly rely on a single reasoning trajectory, resulting in rankings that are susceptible to reasoning errors and inherently constrained in modeling the multifaceted signals underlying document relevance. To resolve this dilemma, we propose MERIT-Rank(Multi-perspective Evidence and Reasoning Integration for Text Reranking), a framework that models complementary reasoning trajectories to improve reranking robustness. MERIT-Rank formulates a Multi-Trajectory Reasoning Space (MTRS) that evaluates query-document relevance from multiple perspectives and introduces a joint reranker that consolidates these reasoning paths into a unified ranking decision. We further develop Progressive Rank Policy Optimization (PRPO), a progressive training framework that stabilizes reasoning trajectories while continually improving ranking quality through staged optimization objectives. Experiments on both reasoning-intensive and traditional retrieval benchmarks show that MERIT-Rank consistently achieves superior performance over competitive baselines. The 4B model notably outperforms most 7B and even 32B rerankers on BRIGHT.
title: Think Thrice Before Reranking: Multi-perspective Evidence and Reasoning Integration for Text Reranking
title_translated: 三思而后重排：多视角证据与推理融合用于文本重排
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的推理重排已显示出在文本排序方面的显著改进。然而，当前方法主要依赖单一推理轨迹，导致排序易受推理错误影响，且在建模文档相关性背后的多方面信号方面存在固有限制。为解决这一困境，我们提出MERIT-Rank（多视角证据与推理融合文本重排框架），通过建模互补的推理轨迹来提升重排鲁棒性。MERIT-Rank构建了一个多轨迹推理空间（MTRS），从多个视角评估查询-文档相关性，并引入联合重排器将这些推理路径整合为统一的排序决策。我们进一步开发了渐进式重排策略优化（PRPO），一种渐进式训练框架，通过分阶段优化目标稳定推理轨迹，同时持续提升排序质量。在推理密集型和传统检索基准上的实验表明，MERIT-Rank在性能上持续优于多种竞争基线。4B规模模型在BRIGHT数据集上显著优于大多数7B甚至32B的重排器。

summary: Tool learning enables large language models (LLMs) to use external tools for tasks beyond parametric knowledge. Reinforcement learning can optimize tool-call behavior from feedback, but current methods still face two problems: fixed-threshold curricula can become misaligned with the policy's evolving capability boundary, and additive rewards can leak argument-level credit when the predicted tool is wrong. To address these problems, we propose MATCH, a closed-loop framework for model-aware tool learning with curriculum scheduling and hierarchically gated rewards. Model-Aware Curriculum Learning (MACL) maintains reward-derived sample difficulty that co-evolves with the policy, and each epoch selects samples near the current capability boundary together with a top-k pool of harder cases. Hierarchical Tool-call Gated Reward (HTGR) scores tool name, argument key, and argument value as a gated chain, granting credit at each level only when prerequisites hold. The same HTGR rewards drive both GRPO updates and MACL's difficulty refresh, closing the loop between policy optimization and sample scheduling. On API-Bank and BFCL V3, MATCH reaches 72.19% and 62.87% overall accuracy, outperforming the main supervised and RL-based baselines. Backbone experiments further show consistent improvements across four backbones from two model families.
title: MATCH: Model-Aware Tool Learning with Curriculum Scheduling and Hierarchically Gated Rewards
title_translated: MATCH：基于课程调度与分层门控奖励的模型感知工具学习
summary_translated: 工具学习使大型语言模型（LLMs）能够利用外部工具完成超出参数知识的任务。强化学习可从反馈中优化工具调用行为，但现有方法仍面临两个问题：固定阈值的课程可能与策略能力边界的演变脱节，而加性奖励在预测工具错误时可能导致参数级信用泄漏。为解决这些问题，我们提出MATCH——一种闭环的模型感知工具学习框架，结合课程调度与分层门控奖励。模型感知课程学习（MACL）维护由奖励衍生的样本难度，并随策略共同演化；每轮选取靠近当前能力边界的样本，同时搭配一个top-k的更难案例池。分层工具调用门控奖励（HTGR）将工具名称、参数键和参数值视为门控链，仅在前提满足时才授予各层级信用。相同的HTGR奖励同时驱动GRPO更新和MACL的难度刷新，实现策略优化与样本调度之间的闭环。在API-Bank和BFCL V3数据集上，MATCH分别达到72.19%和62.87%的整体准确率，优于主要的监督和基于RL的基线。骨干实验进一步显示，跨两个模型家族的四种主干模型均取得一致提升。

summary: This paper builds a theoretical bridge between the economic notion of marginal utility and two machine-learning constructs, matrix factorization and the Key--Value cache of transformer language models. The singular value spectrum of a rating matrix is shown to be a diminishing marginal utility schedule for latent factors, the eigenvalue spectrum of the projected covariance operator to be the marginal utility schedule of a model's learned representation, and cache eviction and low-rank cache compression to be instances of constrained utility maximization under a memory budget. The three collapse into a single allocation rule: retain the top dimensions whose eigenvalue exceeds the shadow price of the binding constraint. The framework is applied to the automated extraction of structured information from geo-mining documents, where it motivates a multi-pass inference protocol, a layer-wise TIES model merging procedure, and a selection policy combining extraction quality, localization drift and energy, scalarized with a Conditional Value-at-Risk term on drift. Two empirical contributions are reported. An 11.2-million-parameter hierarchical classifier, trained in about five minutes on a single GPU, reaches 90.0 per cent level-1 accuracy on a held-out test set from a 973-document uranium-exploration corpus, against 92.0 per cent for a proprietary model on a fifty-document human audit of the same corpus, at a latency of 2.62 ms per card against approximately 2,000 ms for the API and at negligible cost. A diagnostic of uniform-density TIES merging exposes a reproducible degenerate mode in which the merged model returns token-identical outputs across five geographically distinct districts while declaring high confidence; re-executing the merge under layer-wise calibrated densities removes that signature on the diagnostic sample. The full-scale extraction benchmark, including LoRA fine-tuning, is reported as projected rather than measured and remains an empirical extension of this work.
title: Marginal utility, matrix factorization, and the Key-Value (KV) cache: a unified information-economic framework for sovereign geo-mining inference

title_translated: 边际效用、矩阵分解与键值（KV）缓存：主权地质采矿推理的统一信息经济学框架
summary_translated: 本文构建了经济中的边际效用概念与两种机器学习结构——矩阵分解和Transformer语言模型的键值缓存之间的理论桥梁。评分矩阵的奇异值谱被证明是潜在因子的递减边际效用曲线，投影协方差算子的特征值谱则是模型学习表征的边际效用曲线，而缓存淘汰与低秩缓存压缩则被视为在内存预算约束下的效用最大化实例。三者最终统一为单一分配规则：保留特征值超过绑定约束影子价格的前几个维度。该框架应用于从地质采矿文档中自动提取结构化信息，推动了多轮推理协议、分层TIES模型融合方法以及结合提取质量、定位漂移和能耗的综合选择策略（以条件风险价值项对漂移进行标量处理）。报告了两项实证贡献：一个1120万参数的分层分类器，在单个GPU上训练约五分钟，对973份铀矿勘探文档测试集达到90.0%的一级准确率，优于同一语料库50份人工审计样本上专有模型的92.0%，延迟仅为每卡2.62毫秒，远低于API的约2000毫秒，且成本可忽略；对均匀密度TIES融合的诊断揭示了一种可复现的退化模式：合并模型在五个地理上不同的区域返回完全相同的token输出并声明高置信度；在分层校准密度下重新执行融合后，该诊断样本上的异常特征消失。完整规模的提取基准（包括LoRA微调）目前为预测而非实测，仍属于本工作的经验延伸。

summary: AI systems can strengthen democracy by supporting deliberation at scale by addressing cognitive, social, platform-design, and market-driven frictions, while preserving human agency. Unlike proposals such as liquid democracy that restructure representation through vote delegation, in this position paper, we argue that AI-assisted deliberation offers a more promising path by lowering barriers to meaningful engagement without substituting machine judgment for human choice. Drawing on evidence from online deliberation platforms and experimental research, we identify four guiding principles: preserving agency and autonomy, encouraging mutual respect, promoting equality and inclusiveness, and augmenting rather than substituting active citizenship. We also address critical challenges, including alignment, sycophancy, training bias, and over-reliance on AI systems. We call on the machine learning community to develop deliberation-focused AI systems evaluated not on engagement metrics but on their capacity to facilitate informed, representative, and friction-robust discourse.
title: AI Should Facilitate Democratic Deliberation at Scale
title_translated: 人工智能应促进大规模民主审议
summary_translated: AI系统可通过解决认知、社会、平台设计及市场驱动的摩擦，支持大规模民主审议，同时保持人类自主性。与通过投票委托重构代表制的液态民主等提案不同，本文主张AI辅助审议提供更可行路径：降低有意义参与的门槛，而不以机器判断替代人类选择。基于在线审议平台和实验研究证据，我们提出四项指导原则：保持主体性和自主性、鼓励相互尊重、促进平等与包容、增强而非取代积极公民身份。同时探讨了对齐问题、谄媚行为、训练偏差及对AI系统的过度依赖等关键挑战。我们呼吁机器学习界开发以审议为导向的AI系统，并非以参与度指标评估，而是以促进知情、代表性且抗摩擦对话的能力作为评价标准。

summary: A coding agent halfway through an issue has already read much of what a retriever ranks highest. Relevance is scored per passage, but sufficiency belongs to the set: a ranker can fill its budget with variants of one required fact and leave the decision unsupported. We formulate state-conditioned minimal sufficient evidence recovery: given a captured agent state, recover a compact evidence combination that supplies the support its next decision still lacks. SERBench measures this on 500 held-out states from 45 repositories, recording what the agent has seen and crediting only sets that cover every fact the current decision was annotated to require. MSS-Complement treats acquisition as set construction, not ranking. Three semantic calls propose a jointly sufficient set, search for what it lacks, and return 4-8 intact source units within 6,144 tokens. One configuration, fixed on calibration data, recovers a complete set for 73.0% of those states at five items and 80.6% at eight, against 61.4% and 72.4% for Qwen3 embedding with reranking. A matched control ranking by similarity alone reaches 66.6%, placing the gain in the set-level policy, not the computation. From frozen repository source with no gold-derived pool, the lead is 5.0 points. On AMA-Bench it answers from a 76.2% smaller answer prompt, with accuracy 2.08 points above that benchmark's own memory agent. Removing one required group from an otherwise complete set costs 12.3 and 11.1 points of repair-localization precision under two executors. Retrieval for agents is better posed as recovering what a decision lacks than re-ranking what an issue resembles.
title: The Missing Complement: State-Conditioned Minimal Sufficient Evidence for Coding Agents

title_translated: 缺失的补充：编码智能体的状态条件最小充分证据
summary_translated: 一个处于任务中途的编码智能体已读取了检索器排名最高的大部分内容。相关性按段落打分，但充分性属于整体集合：检索器可能用多个相同事实的变体填满其预算，导致决策缺乏支持。我们提出了状态条件的最小充分证据恢复：给定捕获的智能体状态，恢复一个紧凑的证据组合，补足其下一步决策所缺少的支持。SERBench在45个代码仓库中500个保留状态上测量此任务，记录智能体已见内容，并仅对覆盖当前决策标注所需所有事实的集合给予认可。MSS-Complement将获取视为集合构建而非排序。三个语义调用共同提出一个联合充分集合，搜索其缺失部分，并在6144 token内返回4-8个完整的源单元。一种在校准数据上固定的配置，在五项内容时恢复完整集合的比例达73.0%，八项时达80.6%，优于使用Qwen3嵌入并重排序的61.4%和72.4%。仅靠相似性匹配的对照组达到66.6%，表明收益来自集合层面的策略而非计算本身。在无黄金衍生池的冻结仓库源数据上，领先优势达5.0分。在AMA-Bench上，使用比基准小76.2%的答案提示，准确率高出基准自身记忆代理2.08分。从一个完整集合中移除一个必需组别，导致两个执行器下的修复-定位精度分别下降12.3和11.1分。对于智能体而言，检索应被重新定义为恢复决策所缺失的内容，而非对问题相似性的重排序。

summary: People increasingly turn to AI chatbots for news and explanations of world events. But do they receive the same political answers when they ask in different languages? Here we show that the language of a question can change how the same AI systems assess the war in Ukraine. We ask GPT, Claude and Gemini to evaluate twenty statements about the war in 112 languages, collecting 67,200 responses. The balance between Russia-leaning and Ukraine-leaning responses differs across languages. When we group responses by countries' official languages, they follow a pattern resembling worldwide political divisions: relatively more Russia-leaning answers correspond to more favourable public views of Russia, less support for Ukraine in United Nations votes, and less aid to Ukraine. The broad pattern recurs across all three models and remains when individual statement pairs are removed. Our findings suggest a possible route through which information warfare may shape the text used to train AI models, which may in turn spread geopolitical biases.
title: Geopolitical Divisions Across Languages in Large Language Models
title_translated: 大型语言模型中跨语言的地缘政治分歧
summary_translated: 人们越来越多地向AI聊天机器人寻求新闻和世界事件的解释。但他们用不同语言提问时，是否能得到相同的政治理解？我们发现，问题的语言会影响同一AI系统对乌克兰战争的评估。我们要求GPT、Claude和Gemini在112种语言中评估关于战争的20个陈述，共收集67,200条回应。不同语言间的俄罗斯倾向与乌克兰倾向回答比例存在差异。当按国家官方语言分组响应时，其模式呈现出全球地缘政治分裂的特征：更多俄罗斯倾向的回答对应公众对俄罗斯更友好的态度、联合国投票中对乌克兰支持度更低、对乌克兰援助更少。这一总体模式在所有三个模型中均重现，即使剔除个别陈述对也依然成立。研究结果表明，信息战可能通过影响训练AI模型所用文本的方式传播地缘政治偏见。

summary: Multimodal reasoning requires models to draw on information from multiple modalities throughout the reasoning process. Yet existing methods often concatenate modality-specific thought tokens in a single sequence, leaving the model to bridge representational differences as it reasons across modalities. We introduce Uni-LaDiR (Unified Latent Diffusion Reasoner), a framework that brings these thoughts into a shared latent space for reasoning. A unified encoder maps teacher reasoning steps from different modalities into shared thought tokens, trained to preserve the information needed for later reasoning steps and the final answer or action. Because the same context can support multiple valid next steps, we use diffusion to predict the next block of thought tokens from the input and preceding blocks. Jointly training the encoder and diffusion reasoner with shared model weights encourages thought tokens to be both useful for the task and predictable from the available context. At inference, the model generates these tokens without teacher observations. Across eleven vision-language model (VLM) benchmarks and two vision-language-action (VLA) suites, Uni-LaDiR achieves relative gains over the strongest evaluated baselines of 7.3% on visual reasoning tasks and 6.1% on robot manipulation tasks.
title: Uni-LaDiR: Latent Diffusion Unifies Multimodal Reasoning
title_translated: Uni-LaDiR：潜在扩散统一多模态推理
summary_translated: 多模态推理需要模型在整个推理过程中利用来自多种模态的信息。然而现有方法通常将各模态特有的思维标记串联成单一序列，使模型在跨模态推理时自行弥合表示差异。我们提出Uni-LaDiR（统一潜在扩散推理框架），将这些思维引入共享潜在空间进行推理。统一编码器将来自不同模态的教师推理步骤映射到共享思维标记，训练目标是保留后续推理步骤和最终答案或动作所需的信息。由于同一上下文可支持多个有效下一步，我们采用扩散模型从输入和先前块中预测下一个思维块。通过共享模型权重联合训练编码器与扩散推理器，促使思维标记既对任务有用，又可由可用上下文预测。推理时，模型无需教师观察即可生成这些标记。在11个视觉-语言模型（VLM）基准和2个视觉-语言-动作（VLA）套件上，Uni-LaDiR在视觉推理任务上相对于最强基线提升7.3%，在机器人操作任务上提升6.1%。

summary: High annotation reproducibility does not necessarily imply that an LLM-inferred measure captures the construct it is intended to measure. We test this distinction using a dataset from the European Commission's AI Act consultation, linking structured survey responses to free-text consultation submissions from the same stakeholders. LLM annotations of consultation submissions are highly reproducible (intraclass correlations > 0.99), yet show limited convergence with survey-reported measures of the nominal construct they were intended to approximate. Divergence between survey-and LLM-inferred text-based measures varies systematically across stakeholder groups: business associations express greater concern about AI risks in text-based consultations than in survey responses ({g} = +1.0), whereas public authorities and several nonbusiness groups show smaller or negative divergences. Divergences between scores suggest positive spatial autocorrelation across European countries (Moran's I = 0.347, p = 0.036), indicating that stakeholders from neighboring countries tend toward more similar text-based stances towards AI safety concerns. Despite divergence, survey-reported concerns remain strongly associated with support for explainability across all divergence levels. These results demonstrate that LLM annotation reproducibility can coexist with poor construct correspondence and motivate validation procedures that distinguish reproducibility, construct validity, and communication context variation when LLMs are used as measurement instruments.
title: Reproducibility is not construct validity: LLM measurement of institutionally situated communication
title_translated: 可复现性不等于构念效度：大语言模型对制度化语境下沟通的测量
summary_translated: 高标注可复现性并不必然意味着大语言模型推断的测量指标能够准确捕捉其本应衡量的构念。我们利用欧盟委员会人工智能法案咨询活动的数据集，将结构化调查回答与同一利益相关方的自由文本咨询提交内容进行关联，检验这一区别。大语言模型对咨询文本的标注具有极高的可复现性（组内相关系数 > 0.99），但与调查中报告的名义构念测量结果收敛程度有限。在不同利益相关群体间，调查与大语言模型推断的基于文本的测量结果存在系统性差异：企业协会在文本咨询中表达的AI风险担忧高于调查回答（{g} = +1.0），而公共机构及多个非企业群体则表现出较小或负向差异。评分差异显示出欧洲国家间的正空间自相关（Moran's I = 0.347, p = 0.036），表明邻近国家的利益相关方在AI安全关切上的文本立场趋于相似。尽管存在差异，调查中报告的担忧仍与对可解释性的支持高度相关，且在所有差异水平下均成立。这些结果表明，大语言模型标注的可复现性可以与构念对应性差共存，强调在使用大语言模型作为测量工具时，需区分可复现性、构念效度和沟通语境变化，并建立相应的验证程序。

summary: LLM agents have recently shown promise in automating machine learning engineering by editing model and training code under execution feedback. Data, however, remains largely outside this agentic optimisation loop. We frame pre-training data selection as heuristic engineering over per-document features, i.e., lexical statistics, categorical labels, and perplexity. We introduce AutoData, an agent that searches directly over executable selection algorithms. Unlike prior data mixture methods that optimise weights over a fixed set of domains, AutoData searches a richer program space of scoring, stratification, and stochastic selection rules, discovering feature interactions automatically by iteratively refining algorithms with validation feedback from a proxy model. Within an overnight search, AutoData discovers a selection algorithm that outperforms existing human-designed curation pipelines. Despite being searched only on this small proxy, the discovered recipe transfers to larger scales and improves the downstream metric CORE. These results suggest that data engineering can be treated as an agentic machine learning problem, extending autonomous research from model and training-code optimization to the data.
title: AutoData: Agentic Search for Pre-training Data Selection
title_translated: AutoData：用于预训练数据选择的智能体搜索
summary_translated: 大语言模型智能体最近在通过执行反馈编辑模型和训练代码方面展现出自动化机器学习工程的潜力。然而，数据仍基本游离于这种智能体优化循环之外。我们将预训练数据选择建模为对文档级特征（如词汇统计、类别标签和困惑度）的启发式工程。我们提出了AutoData，一个直接在可执行选择算法空间中进行搜索的智能体。与以往固定领域集合并优化权重的数据混合方法不同，AutoData在更丰富的程序空间中搜索评分、分层和随机选择规则，通过代理模型的验证反馈迭代优化算法，自动发现特征交互。在一夜搜索内，AutoData发现了一种优于现有手工设计数据筛选流程的选择算法。尽管仅在小型代理模型上搜索，该发现的方案仍能迁移至更大规模，并提升下游指标CORE的表现。这些结果表明，数据工程可被视为一种智能体驱动的机器学习问题，将自主研究从模型和训练代码优化扩展到数据层面。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable reasoning capabilities by utilizing chain-of-thought (CoT) as a scratchpad for intermediate stages of thinking. However, CoT techniques require explicit supervision on thinking tokens, which requires rich, task-specific data. In this work, we propose Abstract Token Curriculum (ATC), a novel curriculum learning framework that elicits effective continuous intermediate representations without direct supervision or manual scratchpad design. ATC gradually increases problem complexity through a sequence of distributions, training the model to develop internal abstract ``thoughts'' in the continuous representation space. This paper provides both theoretical and experimental evidence for the benefits of ATC and its advantages over previous methods for training continuous thoughts. Theoretically, we show that for learning parity functions with single-layer softmax attention using ATC, attention naturally focuses on the CoT tokens in the context that provide the ``easiest path'' to predicting the next token. Experimentally, we show ATC's effectiveness on graph reachability and arithmetic learning tasks.
title: Learn Your Own Thoughts: Abstract Token Curriculum
title_translated: 学会自己的思考：抽象标记课程
summary_translated: 大语言模型通过使用思维链（CoT）作为中间思考阶段的草稿板，已实现卓越的推理能力。然而，CoT技术需要对思考标记进行显式监督，这依赖于丰富且任务特定的数据。本文提出一种名为抽象标记课程（ATC）的新颖课程学习框架，无需直接监督或手动草稿板设计即可激发有效的连续中间表示。ATC通过一系列分布逐步增加问题复杂度，训练模型在连续表示空间中发展出内部的抽象“思考”。本文提供了理论和实验证据，证明ATC的优势及其相较于先前连续思考训练方法的优越性。理论上，我们证明在使用单层softmax注意力学习奇偶函数时，ATC能使注意力自然聚焦于上下文中提供“最简单路径”以预测下一个标记的CoT标记。实验上，我们在图可达性和算术学习任务中展示了ATC的有效性。

summary: This paper proposes a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework for scientific image quality assessment, designed to simultaneously address both the understanding track (SIQA-U) and the scoring track (SIQA-S) of the SIQA challenge. We construct a multimodal index that integrates textual semantics with fine-grained visual features, and develop a multi-route retrieval and fusion mechanism to provide large language models with highly relevant reference cases, thereby enhancing their capability to evaluate complex scientific images. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework effectively aligns with the judgment criteria of human experts. Ultimately, our method achieves 1st place in the SIQA-U track of the SIQA challenge at the ICME 2026 Grand Challenges.
title: Scientific Image Quality Assessment via Multi-modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_translated: 通过多模态检索增强生成进行科学图像质量评估
summary_translated: 本文提出一种检索增强生成（RAG）框架，用于科学图像质量评估，旨在同时应对SIQA挑战中的理解任务（SIQA-U）和评分任务（SIQA-S）。我们构建了一个融合文本语义与细粒度视觉特征的多模态索引，并开发了多路径检索与融合机制，为大型语言模型提供高度相关的参考案例，从而增强其评估复杂科学图像的能力。实验结果表明，所提出的框架能有效契合人类专家的判断标准。最终，我们的方法在ICME 2026全球挑战赛的SIQA-U任务中获得第一名。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into vehicle voice assistants. But linking natural-language requests to vehicle functions creates a safety-critical authorization problem. Before executing a command, the system must choose whether to execute, refuse, clarify, require confirmation, defer to manual control, trigger an emergency response, or make no tool call. To our knowledge, prior evaluations do not isolate this pre-action decision across speaker role, authentication status, vehicle state, and tool availability. We introduce a 202-scenario benchmark with Reference Decisions under a seven-class taxonomy. We evaluate two local open-weight models and three API-based LLMs using Decision Alignment and safety-specific error metrics. Alignment ranges from 40.1% for Llama 3.2 3B to 89.1% for Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview. The API-based models score between 83.2% and 89.1%, with no statistically significant differences among them. Even these models produce two to three False Executes among 161 non-execution scenarios, and persistent errors remain in confirmation and manual-control decisions. A controlled Llama 3.2 3B ablation increases alignment to 40.1% under the structured authorization policy, versus 28.2-29.2% under schema-only and generic-safety baselines, but it does not eliminate False Executes. Structured LLM decisions are therefore insufficient as a standalone safety mechanism, and deployment requires an independent enforcement layer that verifies tool permissions and vehicle-state constraints before invoking any vehicle function.
title: From Intent to Action: Benchmarking LLM Safety in Vehicle Voice Command Authorization
title_translated: 从意图到行动：面向车辆语音命令授权的LLM安全性基准测试
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地集成到车辆语音助手之中。但将自然语言请求与车辆功能关联，会引发关键的安全授权问题。在执行命令前，系统必须决定是否执行、拒绝、澄清、要求确认、推迟至手动控制、触发紧急响应，或不调用任何工具。据我们所知，以往的评估并未在说话人角色、认证状态、车辆状态和工具可用性等维度上分离这一预操作决策。我们引入了一个包含202个场景的基准测试，涵盖七类分类下的参考决策。我们采用决策对齐和安全特异性错误指标，评估了两个本地开源权重模型和三个基于API的大语言模型。对齐率从Llama 3.2 3B的40.1%到Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview的89.1%不等。基于API的模型得分在83.2%至89.1%之间，彼此无显著差异。即使这些模型在161个非执行场景中仍产生两到三个误执行，且确认和手动控制决策中持续存在错误。受控的Llama 3.2 3B消融实验在结构化授权策略下将对齐率提升至40.1%，高于仅基于模式和通用安全基线的28.2%-29.2%，但未能消除误执行。因此，结构化的LLM决策不足以作为独立的安全机制，部署时必须引入独立的执行层，以在调用车辆功能前验证工具权限和车辆状态约束。

summary: To keep coding agents from going off the rails, production systems now review each proposed action with a blocking monitor that can reject it before it runs (Auto Mode in Claude Code, Guardian in OpenAI's Codex). Prior evaluations of such monitors largely measure robustness to accidental harm or prompt injections from untrusted sources looking to hijack the agent. Less understood is how they hold up when the agent they monitor is persistently misaligned. To understand this risk, we task an adversarial agent with evading production blocking monitors and causing catastrophic harm, e.g. by exfiltrating its own weights. We find that when instructed with high-level attack strategies, adversarial agents can succeed through several distinct mechanisms, such as agent-generated prompt injection against the monitor, multi-agent attacks, and malicious compaction. In particular we find that in 79% of trials, the agent can use an injection attack against Auto Mode and Guardian to run arbitrary bash commands. We also find that it is possible to greatly improve Auto Mode through design changes like enhancements to tool coverage, transcript formatting and an agentic monitor stage. Even with these improvements, preventing multi-context attacks at an acceptable cost remains an open problem. By detailing our red-teaming methodology and highlighting new attack vectors, we aim to help defenders evaluate their mitigations against the possibility of persistent malign coding agents. Code is available at https://github.com/safety-research/red-teaming-auto-mode.
title: Red-Teaming Auto Mode: Improving Blocking Classifiers Against Malign Coding Agents
title_translated: 红队测试自动模式：提升阻断分类器对抗恶意编码智能体的能力
summary_translated: 为防止编码智能体偏离正轨，生产系统现在通过阻断监控器审查每个提议的操作，在其执行前进行拒绝（Claude Code中的自动模式，OpenAI Codex中的守护者）。以往对这类监控器的评估主要衡量其对意外伤害或来自不可信来源的提示注入攻击的鲁棒性。但对其在被监控智能体持续不一致时的表现了解较少。为理解这一风险，我们让一个对抗性智能体尝试规避生产环境中的阻断监控器并造成灾难性损害，例如窃取自身的权重。我们发现，当被赋予高层次攻击策略时，对抗性智能体可通过多种不同机制成功，如针对监控器的智能体生成提示注入、多智能体攻击以及恶意压缩。特别地，我们在79%的试验中发现，该智能体能通过针对Auto Mode和Guardian的注入攻击运行任意bash命令。我们还发现，通过改进工具覆盖范围、对话格式和引入智能体监控阶段等设计变更，可显著提升Auto Mode。即使如此，以可接受成本防范多上下文攻击仍是开放问题。通过详细阐述我们的红队测试方法并揭示新的攻击向量，我们旨在帮助防御者评估其缓解措施应对持续恶意编码智能体的可能性。代码可在https://github.com/safety-research/red-teaming-auto-mode获取。

summary: Disease severity classification for genetic conditions is subjective and labor-intensive, creating bottlenecks in genomic screening, where commercial panels vary widely in size and overlap. We developed an autonomous AI agent integrating Reasoning and Acting (ReAct) with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to classify 10,211 Human Phenotype Ontology terms. It uses American College of Medical Genetics (ACMG)-endorsed severity guidelines and American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG) quality-of-life criteria to retrieve PubMed literature, generate interpretable reasoning chains, and independently verify claims. At the phenotype level, using expert-curated cohorts, the agent achieved 93.55% accuracy (MCC 0.9237) with 82.6% to 91.4% of claims supported by direct evidence or valid inferences. Gene-level severity was aggregated across 8,738 pairs, identifying 3,283 autosomal recessive pairs with severe or profound presentations. External validation showed 95.2% concordance with Mackenzie's Mission gene list. This system enables standardized panel design by providing reliable, automated classification supported by direct evidence.
title: Large Language Model Agents for Evidence Based Genetic Disease Severity Classification
title_translated: 基于证据的遗传病严重程度分类的大语言模型智能体
summary_translated: 遗传病的严重程度分类具有主观性和劳动密集性，导致基因组筛查中出现瓶颈，因为商业检测面板在规模和重叠度上差异巨大。我们开发了一个自主AI智能体，结合推理与行动（ReAct）和检索增强生成（RAG），对10,211个人类表型本体术语进行分类。该智能体使用美国医学遗传学与基因组学学会（ACMG）认可的严重程度指南和美国妇产科医师学会（ACOG）的生活质量标准，检索PubMed文献，生成可解释的推理链，并独立验证主张。在表型层面，基于专家标注的队列，智能体达到93.55%的准确率（MCC 0.9237），82.6%至91.4%的主张得到直接证据或有效推论支持。在基因层面，对8,738对基因进行严重程度聚合，识别出3,283对常染色体隐性遗传且表现严重或极严重的组合。外部验证显示与Mackenzie使命基因列表有95.2%的一致性。该系统通过提供基于直接证据的可靠自动化分类，实现了标准化检测面板的设计。

summary: Communication is made possible by common ground---the unspoken knowledge that people share and presuppose of one another, whether that be online or offline. In his conception of common ground, Clark (1996) distinguishes between personal and communal common ground, and asserts that the latter is graded: the more community affiliations two people share, the more common ground they share as well. Social media research has invoked this mechanism to explain how users connect, but it has gone largely untested because community memberships are rarely visible and, where they are, they are coupled to user interactions in a way that leads to conflating effects. To circumvent these challenges, this study repurposes Bluesky starter packs (SPs) as user-curated community affiliation labels. Across 191,648 pairs of users, we show that shared lexical repertoire---our proxy for common ground---grows monotonically with the number of SPs that users share, with users sharing a single pack being roughly twice as similar as equally connected strangers. A semantic renormalization of SP co-membership shows furthermore that it is more so the number of topically \emph{distinct} communities, rather than the raw count, in which common ground is graded. Finally, we show that community co-membership adds to common ground independently of proximity in the Bluesky follow network. These results lead to the conclusion that community membership is a measurable, separable, and semantically structured carrier of common ground. Reading it as such makes common ground observable before an exchange rather than inferred from it, and thus opens the door for large-scale observational approaches to a set of questions that have so far only been posed in the laboratory.
title: Finding Common Ground: Graded Communal Knowledge in Bluesky Starter Packs
title_translated: 寻找共同基础：Bluesky启动包中的分级集体知识
summary_translated: 交流得以实现依赖于共同基础——人们共享且默认彼此具备的未言明知识，无论在线还是线下。克拉克（1996）在其共同基础概念中区分了个人与集体共同基础，并认为后者是分级的：两人共享的社区归属越多，其共同基础也越丰富。社交媒体研究曾借用此机制解释用户连接，但由于社区成员身份通常不可见，且在可见时与用户互动耦合，导致效应混淆，因此该机制长期缺乏实证检验。为此，本研究将Bluesky启动包（SPs）重新用作用户自定义的社区归属标签。在191,648对用户中，我们发现共享词汇库（作为共同基础的代理）随共享启动包数量单调增长，共享一个包的用户比同等连接的陌生人相似度高出约一倍。对SP共属关系进行语义归一化后进一步表明，共同基础的分级更取决于所涉主题上**不同**社区的数量，而非原始数量。最后，我们证明社区共属对共同基础的贡献独立于Bluesky关注网络中的接近性。这些结果表明，社区归属是可测量、可分离且语义结构化的共同基础载体。将其视为可预先读取的信号，使共同基础在交流前即可观测，而非事后推断，从而为大规模观察性研究开辟新路径，解决此前仅限于实验室的问题。

summary: Hiring is bilateral: employers assess fit, while candidates present and defend evidence of their qualifications. Yet résumé screening, the first gate, is commonly automated as a static, one-call judgment over a résumé-job pair. We study a two-agent alternative in which employer-side and candidate-side agents represent these roles, exchange evidence, and update their judgments before deciding who advances. We compare procedures on 600 constructed résumé-job pairs using GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.7. Two-agent screening advances more applications (33.3% to 39.3% for GPT-5.5; 34.0% to 35.5% for Opus 4.7). Across three runs on the common 191-pair borderline pool, pass-instance rates rise from 4.5% to 26.2% and from 6.5% to 16.1%, respectively. This is not a uniform relaxation: two-agent screening rejects applications one-call advances, changing decisions in both directions. At similar pass volumes, the procedures advance different applications, and no one-call threshold recovers applications consistently selected by two-agent screening. Among discovery-selected cases re-executed in fresh runs, two-agent-only selections recur less often than shared selections, clearly under GPT-5.5 and less certainly under Opus 4.7, while a separate one-call follow-up shows no comparable decline. As hiring becomes agent-mediated on both sides, the screening procedure, not only the model behind it, shapes who reaches human review and how reliably that access recurs.
title: When Hiring Becomes Agent-Mediated: Evaluating Access and Recurrence in Two-Agent Résumé Screening

title_translated: 招聘变为智能体中介：评估双智能体简历筛选中的访问与重复性
summary_translated: 招聘是双向过程：雇主评估匹配度，候选人展示并辩护自身资质。然而，简历筛选作为第一道关卡，通常被自动化为对简历-职位对的一次性静态判断。我们研究了一种双智能体替代方案，其中雇主侧和候选人侧智能体分别代表双方角色，交换证据并更新判断后再决定谁进入下一环节。我们使用GPT-5.5和Claude Opus 4.7对600个构建的简历-职位对进行比较。双智能体筛选推进的应用比例从33.3%到39.3%（GPT-5.5），34.0%到35.5%（Opus 4.7）。在共有的191对边缘案例池中，通过三轮测试，通过率分别从4.5%升至26.2%，从6.5%升至16.1%。这并非均匀放松：双智能体筛选会否决一次性通过的申请，改变决策方向。在相近通过量下，两种方法推进的应用不同，且没有一次性阈值能稳定恢复双智能体筛选所选的申请。在重新执行的发现选择案例中，双智能体独选项在GPT-5.5下复发率明显低于共享项，而在Opus 4.7下则不那么确定；而单独的一次性后续检查并未显示出类似下降趋势。随着招聘在双方均转向智能体中介，筛选流程本身——而不仅仅是背后的模型——塑造了谁能进入人工评审，以及这种访问的可重复性。

summary: Web agents often revisit the same sites, yet most evaluations discard the procedures learned in earlier successful interactions. We introduce EconSkills, a skill library and evaluation framework that distills verified EconWebArena trajectories into parameterized standard operating procedures for retrieving live economic data. Each skill records its scope, navigation procedure, site-specific guidance, verification checks, and recovery steps while replacing source-instance values with placeholders. EconSkills separates two questions: whether a known relevant procedure transfers to a held-out task, and whether an agent can retain that benefit when selecting from a library. In controlled transfer, matched skills improve success over no-skill prompting and require fewer steps on paired successes, while abstraction is substantially more effective than replaying raw trajectories. At library scale, retrieval is competitive with the no-skill baseline overall and performs best on directly covered tasks; coverage-stratified outcomes show that approximate matches on uncovered tasks offset these gains. Browser trajectories further identify when procedural guidance shortens portal-specific navigation and when semantic verification remains necessary. These results establish that reusable economic web procedures can transfer across task instances and provide a concrete design target for coverage-aware selection and context delivery.
title: EconSkills: Studying Skill Transfer and Retrieval for Web Agents on Live Economic Data
title_translated: EconSkills：研究网络智能体在实时经济数据上的技能迁移与检索
summary_translated: 网络智能体经常重复访问相同网站，但大多数评估忽略了早期成功交互中学习到的程序。我们提出EconSkills，一个技能库与评估框架，将经过验证的EconWebArena轨迹提炼为参数化标准操作流程，用于检索实时经济数据。每项技能记录其作用范围、导航流程、站点特定指导、验证检查及恢复步骤，同时将源实例值替换为占位符。EconSkills分离了两个问题：已知相关流程是否可迁移到未见任务，以及智能体能否在从库中选择时保留该优势。在受控迁移中，匹配技能在成功率上优于无技能提示，且在成功案例中所需步骤更少；抽象方法远优于直接重放原始轨迹。在库规模下，检索整体表现与无技能基线相当，且在直接覆盖的任务上表现最佳；分层覆盖结果表明，对未覆盖任务的近似匹配可抵消部分增益。浏览器轨迹进一步揭示了程序指导何时缩短门户特定导航，以及语义验证何时仍有必要。这些结果确立了可复用的经济网络程序可在任务实例间迁移，并为覆盖率感知的选择与上下文传递提供了具体设计目标。

summary: Autonomous systems increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) yet the safety infrastructure surrounding these models introduces latency and compute overhead. This limits utility in resource-constrained, time-critical deployments. Existing external guardrail models remain blind to the model's internal workings, creating a fundamental assurance gap. We ask: does the model already know when the content is harmful? We extract activations from LLaMA-3.1-8B and train lightweight MLP classifier probes (12.6M parameters) to detect harmful prompts. Evaluated on WildJailbreak, Beavertails, and AEGIS 2.0, our probes achieve F1 scores of 99%, 83%, and 84%, respectively competitive with 1000x larger guard models while cutting latency and compute costs.
title: Safety Beyond the Interface: Detecting Harm via Latent States in Large Language Models
title_translated: 超越界面的安全性：通过大语言模型的潜在状态检测危害
summary_translated: 自主系统越来越多地依赖大语言模型（LLMs），但围绕这些模型的安全基础设施引入了延迟和计算开销，限制了在资源受限、时间敏感场景中的实用性。现有的外部防护模型无法感知模型内部运行机制，造成了根本性的安全保证缺口。我们提出问题：模型是否已经知道内容是否有害？我们从LLaMA-3.1-8B中提取激活值，并训练轻量级MLP分类器探针（1260万参数）来检测有害提示。在WildJailbreak、Beavertails和AEGIS 2.0上的评估显示，我们的探针分别取得了99%、83%和84%的F1分数，与1000倍大的防护模型性能相当，同时显著降低了延迟和计算成本。

summary: The rapid expansion of multimodal models has surfaced formidable bottlenecks in computation, memory, and deployment, catalyzing the rise of Efficient Multimodal Learning (EML) as a pivotal research frontier. Despite intensive progress, a cohesive understanding of what, how, and where efficiency is manifested across the learning stack remains fragmented. This survey systematizes the EML landscape by introducing the first structured, model-to-system taxonomy. We distill insights from over 300 seminal works into three hierarchical levels--model, algorithm, and system--addressing architectural parsimony, execution refinement, and hardware-aware orchestration, respectively. Moving beyond a purely categorical review, we offer a methodological synthesis of the vertical synergies between these layers, elucidating how cross-layer co-design contributes to the fundamental "Efficiency-Utility-Privacy" trade-off. Through an integrative case study of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), we trace the field's evolutionary trajectory from initial structural adjustments to modern full-stack resource orchestration. Furthermore, we provide a holistic discussion and application-specific optimization blueprints for diverse domains and posit a paradigm shift toward self-regulating intelligence, where efficiency is an intrinsic, emergent property of the model's fundamental design rather than a post-hoc constraint. Finally, we present open challenges and future directions that will define the trajectory of EML research. This survey establishes a structured framework for multimodal systems that are not only high-performing and generalizable but natively efficient and ready for ubiquitous deployment. A continuously updated version is available at https://github.com/pwang322/Efficient-Multimodal-Learning-Survey.
title: From Models to Systems: A Comprehensive Survey of Efficient Multimodal Learning
title_translated: 从模型到系统：高效多模态学习的全面综述
summary_translated: 多模态模型的快速扩展暴露出计算、内存和部署方面的重大瓶颈，推动了高效多模态学习（EML）作为关键研究前沿的发展。尽管取得了显著进展，但对效率在学习栈中如何体现、体现在何处仍缺乏统一理解。本综述通过引入首个结构化的‘模型到系统’分类体系，系统化梳理了EML领域。我们从超过300篇重要文献中提炼出三个层次——模型、算法和系统——分别对应架构精简、执行优化和硬件感知协同。超越单纯的分类回顾，我们提出了跨层协同的方法论整合，阐明了跨层协同设计如何促成‘效率-效用-隐私’的根本权衡。通过多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的综合案例研究，我们追溯了该领域从早期结构调整到现代全栈资源协同演进的轨迹。此外，我们为不同应用场景提供了整体讨论与优化蓝图，并提出范式转变：效率应成为智能体基础设计中内生的、涌现的属性，而非事后约束。最后，我们列出了开放挑战与未来方向，将定义EML研究的未来路径。本综述建立了一个结构化框架，使多模态系统不仅高性能、可泛化，而且天生高效，适合广泛部署。持续更新版本可在 https://github.com/pwang322/Efficient-Multimodal-Learning-Survey 获取。

summary: Burnout is a chronic occupational syndrome, and open source is close to a worst case for it: maintainers absorb unbounded demand with no manager to reallocate work and no organization to notice decline. The cost is not only personal. Burnout precedes withdrawal, and in projects sustained by a handful of maintainers, one departure can break infrastructure that thousands of downstream systems depend on. Yet the field has no way to see it coming: self-report inventories, the only existing measure, miss exactly the contributors most in need of detection and cannot be applied retroactively, so the field cannot even ask how common burnout is or what helps.   We present BurnRiSc, a framework that operationalizes the Oldenburg Burnout Inventory's two dimensions, exhaustion and disengagement, as 14 behavioral and linguistic signals computed from GitHub activity and scored against each contributor's own history. The signals aggregate into two weighted dimension scores, with weights learned from labeled cases, and average into a monthly Burnout Risk Score (BRS). In a preliminary evaluation across 68 contributors in ten repositories (ten disclosed burnout cases, twelve comparable-volume collapses, and 46 comparison contributors), sustained BRS elevation precedes 6 of 10 disclosures by 6-15 months, 8 of 10 when adding peak BRS as a second criterion, and 10 of 10 over any prior time frame. We thus present BurnRiSc as evidence that burnout is screenable from public data.
title: BurnRiSc: Toward Non-Invasive Burnout Screening in Open Source from Public Repository Signals

title_translated: BurnRiSc：基于公开代码库信号的非侵入式倦怠筛查
summary_translated: 倦怠是一种慢性职业综合征，而开源项目正是其最严重场景之一：维护者承受无限需求，无管理者重新分配工作，也无组织察觉其状态下滑。代价不仅是个人的，倦怠往往导致退出；在由少数维护者支撑的项目中，一人离开可能破坏数千下游系统所依赖的基础架构。然而，当前领域尚无有效预警手段：自评量表是唯一现有测量工具，却恰好遗漏了最需要被识别的贡献者，且无法回溯应用，因此我们甚至无法了解倦怠的普遍程度或何种干预有效。我们提出BurnRiSc框架，将奥尔登堡倦怠量表的两个维度——耗竭与脱离感——转化为14个基于GitHub活动行为与语言特征的信号，并根据每位贡献者的自身历史进行评分。这些信号聚合为两个加权维度得分，权重通过标注样本学习获得，最终生成月度倦怠风险评分（BRS）。在对10个仓库中68名贡献者的初步评估中（包含10例已披露倦怠、12例类似规模崩溃及46名对照者），持续升高的BRS在6/10披露前6至15个月出现；若加入峰值BRS作为第二标准，则提升至8/10；在任意先前时间范围内则全部覆盖（10/10）。因此，BurnRiSc表明倦怠可从公开数据中被有效筛查。

summary: Spontaneous speech offers a scalable, noninvasive signal for respiratory health assessment, yet interpretable models that generalize across languages remain challenging because disease-related acoustic changes are confounded by language-specific phonetic variation. We present CL-DAF, a Cross-Lingual Disease-Alignment Framework that identifies acoustic dimensions whose disease effects remain consistent across languages. Using 201 English and 75 newly collected Bangla speakers, we construct a common 272-dimensional acoustic representation and quantify disease alignment using signed rank-biserial effects and the Language Invariance Score. We first show that spontaneous Bangla speech separates COPD from controls (AUC 0.85); however, 133 features reverse their disease direction across languages and the full representation transfers poorly (AUC 0.49 from Bangla to English). CL-DAF isolates 26 disease-aligned features that raise AUCs to 0.825 and 0.722 from English to Bangla and Bangla to English, respectively. These findings provide a foundation for multilingual clinical speech models emphasizing pathology over language-dependent variation.
title: A Cross-Lingual Acoustic Disease-Alignment Framework for Respiratory Health Assessment from Spontaneous Speech
title_translated: 跨语言声学疾病对齐框架：基于自发语音的呼吸健康评估
summary_translated: 自发语音提供了一种可扩展、非侵入式的呼吸健康评估信号，但跨语言可解释模型仍面临挑战，因为疾病相关的声学变化常被语言特有的发音差异所混淆。我们提出CL-DAF——跨语言疾病对齐框架，旨在识别在不同语言间疾病影响保持一致的声学维度。基于201名英语和75名新采集的孟加拉语说话人数据，我们构建了一个共有的272维声学表示，并使用符号秩双相关效应和语言不变性得分量化疾病对齐程度。我们首先证明，自发孟加拉语语音能有效区分慢阻肺患者与健康对照组（AUC 0.85）；然而，133个特征在不同语言中疾病方向反转，完整表示跨语言迁移效果差（从孟加拉语到英语AUC仅为0.49）。CL-DAF筛选出26个疾病对齐特征，使跨语言迁移AUC分别提升至0.825（英语→孟加拉语）和0.722（孟加拉语→英语）。这些发现为强调病理特征而非语言依赖变异的多语言临床语音模型奠定了基础。

summary: Scaling deep learning faces critical bottlenecks: data exhaustion, exponential training costs, and resource concentration. Model merging combines pre-trained checkpoints without gradient descent, offering orders-of-magnitude savings versus retraining. Combining independently trained vision models is difficult when their architectures and parameter shapes differ. Existing weight-space merging methods generally assume aligned, shape-compatible checkpoints, whereas a Vision Transformer (ViT) and a state-space model (SSM) implement token mixing with different operators. We study a hybrid Heterogeneous merging setting that retains both architectures while aligning parameter groups by semantic role. Our proposed Riemannian--Lorentz Parameter Fusion (RLPF) method projects aligned groups to common coordinates, lifts selected coordinates to the Lorentz hyperboloid model of hyperbolic space, computes a regularized geodesic barycenter, and decodes the result into the two branches. A learned gate then combines branch logits for each input. Component groups use fixed curvature values, with normalization parameters treated as Euclidean. In the results available in this manuscript, the fine-tuned system obtains 82.37\% on CIFAR-10, 75.04\% on Oxford-IIIT Pet, and 78.58\% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K; the corresponding best-parent accuracies are 76.54\%, 71.42\%, and 76.42\%. On ImageNet-1K, the reported pre-fine-tuning initialization reaches 77.80\%. These results support further study of geometry-aware heterogeneous fusion, but not a training-free single-checkpoint merge: RLPF is a two-branch hybrid whose gate and reported final models are trained.
title: Riemannian--Lorentz Fusion of Vision Transformers and State-Space Models
title_translated: 黎曼-洛伦兹融合视觉变换器与状态空间模型
summary_translated: 深度学习的规模化面临关键瓶颈：数据枯竭、训练成本指数级增长以及资源集中化。模型合并无需梯度下降即可结合预训练检查点，相比重新训练可节省数量级的计算资源。然而，当视觉变换器（ViT）与状态空间模型（SSM）架构和参数形状不同时，独立训练的模型合并变得困难。现有权重空间合并方法通常假设检查点对齐且形状兼容，而ViT与SSM使用不同的令牌混合操作。我们研究一种保留两种架构的异构合并设置，通过语义角色对齐参数组。我们提出的黎曼-洛伦兹参数融合（RLPF）方法将对齐组投影到共同坐标系，将选定坐标提升至双曲空间的洛伦兹超球面模型，计算正则化测地线质心，并解码结果至两条分支。一个学习得到的门控机制将各输入的分支logits进行组合。组件组采用固定曲率值，归一化参数视为欧几里得空间。在本文提供的结果中，微调系统在CIFAR-10上达到82.37%，在Oxford-IIIT Pet上达到75.04%，在ImageNet-1K上达到78.58%的top-1准确率；对应的最佳父模型准确率为76.54%、71.42%和76.42%。在ImageNet-1K上，报告的预微调初始化已达77.80%。这些结果支持进一步研究几何感知的异构融合，但并非无训练的单检查点合并：RLPF是一个双分支混合模型，其门控机制和最终报告模型均经过训练。

summary: Safety tuning pipelines judge only the final answer, which makes it difficult to distinguish robust refusal from two undesirable shortcuts: blanket refusal on benign requests and polished but unfaithful safety rationales that do not actually constrain the answer. We propose AUDITPLAN, a single-model plan-then-answer approach where the model first emits a compact structured safety plan and then answers conditioned on it. The plan records a threat label, intended action, and explicit constraints, enabling machine-checkable auditing while remaining hidden from users at deployment. We train this behavior with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning with FAITHGATE, a reward-gating objective that grants answer reward only when the safety plan is correct. This discourages safe-looking but unfaithful behavior and promotes tighter plan-answer coupling. Across Qwen backbones, AUDITPLAN improves both robustness and auditability: on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, FAITHGATE reduces ASR from 24.0% to 11.6%, LSR from 1.0% to 0.36%, and over-refusal from 11.0% to 2.0%, outperforming answer-only RL, free-form explanation, and weighted-sum structured rewards. Similar trends hold for Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct. Larger-model confirmation runs on Qwen-3-4B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct preserve the same trend suggesting that explicit internal commitments can make safety alignment more faithful, robust, and auditable.
title: AUDITPLAN: Commit, Then Answer for Auditable Safety Alignment
title_translated: AUDITPLAN：承诺后回答以实现可审计的安全对齐
summary_translated: 安全调优流程仅评估最终答案，难以区分稳健的拒绝与两种不良捷径：对良性请求的全盘拒绝，以及看似合理但不忠实的安全理由，这些理由并未真正约束答案。我们提出AUDITPLAN，一种单模型先规划后回答的方法，模型首先生成一个紧凑的结构化安全计划，然后基于该计划进行回答。该计划记录威胁标签、预期行为和明确约束，支持机器可检查的审计，同时在部署时对用户保持隐藏。我们通过监督微调结合强化学习（使用FAITHGATE奖励门控目标）训练该行为，仅当安全计划正确时才给予回答奖励。这抑制了表面安全但不忠实的行为，并促进计划与回答之间的更强耦合。在Qwen系列模型上，AUDITPLAN提升了鲁棒性和可审计性：在Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct上，FAITHGATE将ASR从24.0%降至11.6%，LSR从1.0%降至0.36%，过度拒绝从11.0%降至2.0%，优于仅回答的强化学习、自由形式解释和加权求和结构化奖励。Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct也呈现类似趋势。在更大模型（Qwen-3-4B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）上的确认实验保持相同趋势，表明显式内部承诺可使安全对齐更忠实、更鲁棒、更可审计。

summary: Design verification remains one of the most resource-intensive stages of hardware development, often consuming up to 70% of the total design effort. While recent work has explored using Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate testbench generation, most existing approaches focus narrowly on functional correctness, overlooking the critical aspect of coverage quality. To bridge this gap, we present CovR, an agentic framework for automated testbench generation that combines self-reflection loops with simulation-based feedback to maximize coverage. Using this pipeline, we construct a large-scale dataset of 16,514 natural specification RTL reasoning testbench tuples with a strong teacher model, enabling coverage-aware supervision. Building on this, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL) framework tailored for coverage-driven testbench generation, leveraging tool-derived rewards from simulation and coverage feedback to optimize a student model. Experimental results show that the CovR finetuned model achieves 93.81% cov@10 on VerilogEval and RTLLM V2.0, and 87.76% cov@10 on CVDP, outperforming state-of-the-art approaches by 7.97% and 3.59%, respectively. Furthermore, deploying the finetuned model back into the agentic refinement pipeline further improves cov@10 to 94.27% on VerilogEval and RTLLM V2.0 and 91.39% on CVDP. Moreover, when integrated as a plug-in stimulus engine for full verification workflows, CovR improves coverage by 18.95% and mutation detection score by 1.19%, while revealing 4.46% undetected failures, highlighting the importance of optimizing for coverage in LLM-based hardware verification.
title: CovR: Coverage-Aware Hardware Verification via Reasoning-Guided Reinforcement Learning
title_translated: CovR：基于推理引导强化学习的覆盖率感知硬件验证
summary_translated: 设计验证仍是硬件开发中最耗资源的阶段，常占总设计工作量的70%。尽管近期研究探索使用大语言模型（LLMs）自动化测试平台生成，但多数现有方法仅关注功能正确性，忽视了覆盖率质量这一关键方面。为弥合这一差距，我们提出CovR，一种用于自动化测试平台生成的智能体框架，结合自我反思循环与基于仿真的反馈以最大化覆盖率。利用该流程，我们构建了一个包含16,514个自然规范RTL推理测试平台元组的大规模数据集，采用强教师模型进行训练，实现覆盖率感知的监督。在此基础上，我们提出一种专为覆盖率驱动的测试平台生成设计的强化学习（RL）框架，利用仿真和覆盖率反馈生成的工具奖励来优化学生模型。实验结果表明，经CovR微调的模型在VerilogEval和RTLLM V2.0上达到93.81% cov@10，在CVDP上达到87.76% cov@10，分别优于最先进方法7.97%和3.59%。此外，将微调模型重新部署回智能体精炼流程后，VerilogEval和RTLLM V2.0的cov@10进一步提升至94.27%，CVDP提升至91.39%。同时，作为完整验证工作流中的插件刺激引擎集成时，CovR使覆盖率提升18.95%，突变检测得分提高1.19%，并发现4.46%未被检测到的故障，凸显在LLM驱动的硬件验证中优化覆盖率的重要性。

summary: Whether human or large language model (LLM), an agent in a discussion reads only a few of the others' contributions, bounded by cognition, context, or cost. LLM collectives can settle on a wrong consensus even when a majority starts out correct; we ask how far that reading bound alone decides the outcome. We model the bound with one number, the message capacity, which sets how many of the others' messages an agent reads, and generate the communication network from it. Over 31,824 randomized queries, we found that an 8-billion-parameter model's judgment of a claim effectively reduces to a logistic function of a weighted sum of its inbox, the update rule of a stochastic binary neuron with divisively normalized weights. From these weights and the network's degree statistics alone, the wrong consensus should become unreachable from any start once agents read, on average, fewer than 6.4 of their 31 sources. In 1,414 episodes with assigned starts the prediction failed: the correct side won in fewer than 50% of episodes from every start, and in only 28-45% when 75% of agents started correct. The failure traces to the field, the threshold that a claim's wording sets for the agent's answer before any message is read: the experimental claims' fields lay below the calibration mean, and with each claim's own field the same weights reproduce the outcomes. Reversing the wording showed that the threshold follows what a claim asserts, not whether it is true. On a second 8B model the pipeline predicts claim-dependent bistability; transition points appeared where computed, and an eight-claim calibration matched in 15 of 16 conditions. At 70B the assertion bias is not detected. Thus a collective's fate is largely set by two single-agent measurements: the threshold a claim's wording sets, and the message capacity that sets the transition point.
title: Message capacity and claim wording set the transition points of collective truth-finding in language-model networks
title_translated: 消息容量与陈述措辞决定了语言模型网络中集体真理发现的转变点
summary_translated: 无论是人类还是大语言模型（LLM），讨论中的代理只能阅读其他参与者贡献的一小部分，受限于认知、上下文或成本。即使多数初始判断正确，LLM集体仍可能达成错误共识；我们探究仅由阅读范围限制是否足以决定结果。我们用一个数值——消息容量——来建模这一限制，表示代理能阅读的他人消息数量，并由此生成通信网络。在31,824次随机查询中，我们发现一个80亿参数模型对某主张的判断实质上是其收件箱加权和的逻辑函数，符合具有除法归一化权重的随机二元神经元更新规则。仅从这些权重和网络度统计特征即可推断，一旦代理平均阅读少于其31个来源中的6.4个，错误共识将无法达成。在1,414次设定起始状态的实验中，预测失败：无论起始状态如何，正确一方获胜比例均低于50%，当75%的代理起始正确时，胜率仅为28%-45%。失败根源在于“场域”——主张措辞在任何消息读取前为代理回答设定的阈值：实验主张的场域低于校准均值，且使用各主张自身的场域，相同的权重可复现结果。反转措辞显示，该阈值取决于主张内容本身，而非其真假。在第二个8B模型上，该流程预测出依赖主张的双稳态；转变点出现在计算位置，且16种条件中有15种与校准匹配。在70B模型上则未检测到主张偏差。因此，集体命运主要由两个单代理测量决定：主张措辞设定的阈值，以及决定转变点的消息容量。

summary: Benchmarks are central to how progress in large language models (LLMs) is assessed and communicated. Yet model rankings alone reveal little about how evaluation requirements themselves are changing. The expanding variety of benchmarks offers another perspective: what researchers expect LLMs to do, and what they count as successful performance. We systematically map 14,767 papers introducing or updating evaluation resources from arXiv submissions between January 2022 and August 2026. Using staged screening and automated full-text coding, we examine changes in target systems and domains, evaluation materials and conditions, and scoring mechanisms. The collection shows growing emphasis on action, interaction, and professional applications, while established and newer design elements frequently coexist. Model participation also develops unevenly: LLM-based scoring grows within both agent and non-agent groups, whereas model-generated materials show no comparable sustained increase in recent cohorts. These findings illuminate how public research translates capability expectations into concrete tests and criteria for success. As AI participates in constructing tests, performing tasks, and judging responses, they also raise a question: does expanding evaluation provide more independent evidence, or risk reproducing the preferences and blind spots of its participating models?
title: What Do We Expect from LLMs? Mapping the Design of LLM Benchmarks

title_translated: 我们对大语言模型有何期待？大语言模型基准设计的映射研究
summary_translated: 基准测试是衡量大语言模型（LLMs）进展与传播的核心手段。然而，仅凭模型排名无法揭示评估要求自身的变化。不断扩展的基准多样性提供了另一视角：研究人员期望LLMs完成什么任务，以及他们如何定义成功表现。我们系统地分析了2022年1月至2026年8月arXiv提交的14,767篇引入或更新评估资源的论文。通过分阶段筛选与自动化全文编码，我们考察了目标系统与领域、评估材料与条件、评分机制等方面的变化。结果显示，研究重点日益转向行动、交互与专业应用，而传统与新兴设计元素常共存。模型参与也发展不均：LLM评分在代理与非代理群体中均持续增长，而模型生成的评估材料在近期群体中并无相应持续上升趋势。这些发现揭示了公共研究如何将能力期望转化为具体的测试与成功标准。随着AI参与构建测试、执行任务、评判响应，也引发一个问题：不断扩展的评估是否提供了更多独立证据，还是可能重复其参与模型的偏好与盲点？
